711b93cd:ba419f8cabfdc1fc5fe37df6407a11e.content: The documents herein define the required inputs for a valid Invocation of the Root Edit Primitive. If any input is noncompliant or omitted, the Primitive will be invalidated and the Root Edit Primitive will not be set up.

711b93cd:c6ec79bf6c8358f4390d9878a77c8d6.title: Root Edit Primitive Artifact Update
711b93cd:c6ec79bf6c8358f4390d9878a77c8d6.content: After the voting period ends, the Operational Facilitator reviews the outcome of the vote. If the vote is successful, the Operational Facilitator actions the Artifact Edit in the Powerhouse system. In either case, the Operational Facilitator records the outcome of the vote, including all pertinent materials, in the Powerhouse system.

711b93cd:44dd59ef8903e252220eea540d064e9.title: Root Edit Primitive Activation Status
711b93cd:44dd59ef8903e252220eea540d064e9.content: The Root Edit Primitive must be Globally Activated.

711b93cd:a16a9466b3c8edba2921dc1a582fa55.title: Artifact Edit Process
711b93cd:a16a9466b3c8edba2921dc1a582fa55.content: The Root Edit Primitive must specify the process by which updates to the Agent Artifact may be made by Agent token holder vote. The details of this process may be specified by the Agent, subject to the following conditions: (1) Agent token holders must vote to approve Artifact Edit proposals, (2) the Operational Facilitator must review each proposal for alignment and conformance with the process specified in the Root Edit Primitive, (3) the vote must be conducted by the Operational Facilitator, and (4) the Operational Facilitator must action the Artifact Edit if the vote passes. The process definition must include the elements included in the documents herein.

711b93cd:81e39420528e5e18dbd6524141b7b18.title: Proposal Format
711b93cd:81e39420528e5e18dbd6524141b7b18.content: The Root Edit Primitive must specify the required format of proposals.

711b93cd:d1de35c78030c99a923fa3f8a055cd3.title: Token SkyLink Input Requirements
711b93cd:d1de35c78030c99a923fa3f8a055cd3.content: The documents herein define the required inputs for a valid Token SkyLink Primitive. If any input is noncompliant or omitted, the Primitive will be invalidated and the SkyLink deployment will not move forward.

711b93cd:13494a36a66b4210fcacc635e389e33.title: Token SkyLink Management Settlement Cycle
711b93cd:13494a36a66b4210fcacc635e389e33.content: During each settlement cycle, the Star Agent Reimbursement Module tallies the total token bridging volume on the new chain. The Star Agent Reimbursement Module calculates the reimbursement due for bridge development costs as a percent of the token bridging volume, in addition to normal Accessibility Rewards if applicable. Core GovOps executes a payment to the Star Agent for the amount due for reimbursement of bridge development costs, to the extent that such costs have not already been fully reimbursed. Core GovOps updates the Powerhouse system to reflect the amount of bridge development costs that have been reimbursed.

711b93cd:66cf7d8426e204b57366f9dab26e9b2.title: Token SkyLink Activation Status
711b93cd:66cf7d8426e204b57366f9dab26e9b2.content: The Token SkyLink Primitive must be Globally Activated.

711b93cd:276500bcbbdbe4784237ca489c57a1b.title: Token SkyLink Ongoing Management
711b93cd:276500bcbbdbe4784237ca489c57a1b.content: The documents herein define the process for managing an Instance of the Token SkyLink Primitive.

711b93cd:defefbaacc00613b49a16a90b3ca265.title: List of Active Token SkyLink Deployments
711b93cd:defefbaacc00613b49a16a90b3ca265.content: The Token SkyLink Primitive must list each active Token SkyLink deployment. The listing must include the following information: (1), the token being bridged, (2) the target chain of the bridge, (3) the address of the bridge contract on the Ethereum Mainnet, (4) the address of the bridge contract on the target chain, (5) the audit of the bridge contract, (6) the bridge parameters, (7) the total bridge deployment and audit costs, and (8) the amount of bridge deployment and audit costs that have been reimbursed to date.

711b93cd:966ed89724a8b561ef4c5bcc72bef07.title: Demand Side Stablecoin Primitives
711b93cd:966ed89724a8b561ef4c5bcc72bef07.content: Demand Side Stablecoin Primitives are Sky Primitives that target demand generation for USDS. Star Agents can create and control multiple instances of these Primitives which exist as technical infrastructure incentivizing the adoption or usage of USDS by end users or third parties.

9eedc5bc:5e4e7d21297bbba0adaa56228df0625.title: Executor Transformation Primitive
9eedc5bc:5e4e7d21297bbba0adaa56228df0625.content: The Executor Transformation Primitive allows an Agent to transform into an Executor Agent, subject to certain conditions.

711b93cd:1b024af1cdc90c6ae7cb47418675ad7.title: Governance Accessibility Rewards Paid To Star Agents
711b93cd:1b024af1cdc90c6ae7cb47418675ad7.content: 0.5% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to Star Agents that manage the rewards for Governance Integrators, incentivizing the active participation of Star Agents. See A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 1: Security and Stability Maintenance - Governance Accessibility Rewards Paid To Integrators.

711b93cd:f95d85532de23b1c9c2a29a71599e7d.title: Governance Accessibility Rewards Paid To Integrators
711b93cd:f95d85532de23b1c9c2a29a71599e7d.content: 0.5% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to frontends and other Integrators that facilitate accessible governance, following security and information standards specified in the Atlas. These standards will be specified in a future iteration of the Atlas. See A.2.4 - Core Governance Reward Primitive.

711b93cd:9f3eef5c1781c063ad161e7e4db7fd3.title: Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards
711b93cd:9f3eef5c1781c063ad161e7e4db7fd3.content: 5% of the Step 2 Capital is allocated to High Activity Staking Rewards (”HASR”) as specified in the documents herein. The remaining 95% of Step 2 Capital becomes Step 3 Capital.

711b93cd:dcc71e080c0f5a97b84b59ab85176c9.title: Voluntary Reduction By Aligned Delegates
711b93cd:dcc71e080c0f5a97b84b59ab85176c9.content: Aligned Delegates may agree to voluntarily reduce their compensation in order to incentivize SKY holders to delegate to them. To the extent that Aligned Delegates reduce their compensation, Step 2 Capital is increased by a corresponding amount. The mechanism by which Aligned Delegates may agree to reduce their compensation will be specified in a future iteration of the Atlas.

711b93cd:20bf8eeb257dfc45f2e3da9373f3070.title: Purpose
711b93cd:20bf8eeb257dfc45f2e3da9373f3070.content: High Activity Staking Rewards provide a boosted staking reward to SKY stakers that delegate their SKY through compliant Governance Accessibility frontends and provide feedback to their delegates every three (3) months. This ensures that there is a minimum amount of SKY that is always actively following current events and governance to detect potential misalignment or buildup of hidden risks.

711b93cd:189c5bcbb7ac8afbe12e1f40865c137.title: Aligned Delegates
711b93cd:189c5bcbb7ac8afbe12e1f40865c137.content: Up to 1% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to Aligned Delegates.

711b93cd:f00f2441e3d63b99815b2cb90b7c2e5.title: Funding Of High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer
711b93cd:f00f2441e3d63b99815b2cb90b7c2e5.content: 5% of the Step 2 Capital is allocated to funding the High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer (HASRB) linearly over the course of the month. Funds from the High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer are then paid out to Governance Accessibility Integrators as specified in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards - Payout From High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer. Governance Accessibility Integrators are in turn responsible for distributing those funds to High Activity Stakers as specified in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards - High Activity Staker Qualification.

711b93cd:d2558fc23ac4c47182628f609d1153f.title: Sourcing Of Internal Senior Risk Capital
711b93cd:d2558fc23ac4c47182628f609d1153f.content: ISRC is sourced from the various surplus buffers, which are themselves funded via the Treasury Management Function. See A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps.

711b93cd:a8889b4517480087bac6511450d9dad.title: Senior Risk Capital System Implementation
711b93cd:a8889b4517480087bac6511450d9dad.content: The documents herein define operational requirements and protocols for the implementation of the Senior Risk Capital system in the Risk Framework.

711b93cd:96b4bd4f53d8ca235b2bbca4fb3301b.title: External Senior Risk Capital And srUSDS System
711b93cd:96b4bd4f53d8ca235b2bbca4fb3301b.content: The documents herein define rules and infrastructure pertaining to the sourcing of External Senior Risk Capital (ESRC). ESRC is capital provided by external investors to be invested as Senior Risk Capital of Star Agents.

711b93cd:0407f9abc9ce30ea38568683768a68a.title: Tokenized External JRC System Implementation
711b93cd:0407f9abc9ce30ea38568683768a68a.content: This document will be further developed in a future iteration of the Atlas.

711b93cd:89ca37aa98923886f276ce6b28b7735.title: srUSDS Contract
711b93cd:89ca37aa98923886f276ce6b28b7735.content: srUSDS is the tokenized form of External Senior Risk Capital. Users can deposit USDS into the srUSDS contract to provide External Senior Risk Capital to the SRC system, making it available for origination by Star Agents. See A.3.3 - Senior Risk Capital (SRC) Origination Process. srUSDS holders can potentially earn higher yields in exchange for the risk that the External Senior Risk Capital will suffer losses.

711b93cd:75c6015a8739870262786482b79faf0.title: Star External JRC Rental System Implementation
711b93cd:75c6015a8739870262786482b79faf0.content: The implementation of the SEJRC rental system is defined as a Sky Primitive, specifically, the Junior Risk Capital Rental Primitive. See A.2.4 - Junior Risk Capital Rental Primitive.

711b93cd:56aa24cf6045d7494e38b56777663b3.title: Deposit And Redemption Queues
711b93cd:56aa24cf6045d7494e38b56777663b3.content:
The srUSDS contract utilizes distinct queues for managing conversions. Users can add USDS to the deposit queue for conversion into srUSDS; or add srUSDS to the redemption queue for conversion back into USDS at any point during the month.

Assets placed in either queue can be withdrawn by the user at any time before the Monthly Settlement Cycle begins.

At the Monthly Settlement Cycle, all assets remaining in the queues are processed: queued USDS is converted into srUSDS, and queued srUSDS is converted into USDS based on the prevailing Conversion Rate. See A.3.3 - Conversion Rate.

711b93cd:7deb39459ac0849ae2e7c9350c24d02.title: Treasury Management Function-Derived Voting Rewards
711b93cd:7deb39459ac0849ae2e7c9350c24d02.content: USDS rewards are distributed via two distinct mechanisms based on the staker’s activity level: the High Activity Staking Reward (HASR) and the Standard Activity Staking Reward (SASR). SASR is the base reward when funding from the Treasury Management Function is available; HASR is an additional boost reserved for High-Activity wallets. See A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards - Payout From High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer.

711b93cd:9dcff0e858ec349f038642b30be3f32.title: Sources of Voting Rewards
711b93cd:9dcff0e858ec349f038642b30be3f32.content: SKY stakers are eligible to receive voting rewards sourced from the Sky Treasury Management Function (TMF) or the Agent Token Distribution mechanism defined in A.4.5.

711b93cd:ce90d8d08aad98fcaa351c3ff1cb658.title: Activity Levels
711b93cd:ce90d8d08aad98fcaa351c3ff1cb658.content: At the Monthly Settlement Cycle, all SKY-staking wallets are tagged as High Activity or Standard Activity, pursuant to the criteria defined in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards - High Activity Staker Qualification and A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 4: Smart Burn And Standard Activity Staking Rewards - Standard Activity Staking Rewards - Standard Activity Staker Qualification. Only High Activity wallets share HASR; both High and Standard Activity wallets share SASR.

711b93cd:bfb838bcab76bf54c14bf8554fb6555.title: SKY Staking Voting Rewards
711b93cd:bfb838bcab76bf54c14bf8554fb6555.content: The documents herein define the SKY Staking Voting Rewards. SKY stakers may choose between receiving USDS or Agent Token rewards.

711b93cd:14629e34d62c931a9f40a4d9305ad3b.title: High Activity Staking Rewards
711b93cd:14629e34d62c931a9f40a4d9305ad3b.content: The High Activity Staking Rewards (HASR) is a boosted reward provided to High Activity wallets. The HASR amount is distributed each monthly cycle pro-rata to the SKY stake of all High Activity wallets. High Activity wallets receive SASR (when funding is available) plus their separate HASR boost.

711b93cd:75b465748b4aa847e0eaec3699f91dc.title: SKY Staking
711b93cd:75b465748b4aa847e0eaec3699f91dc.content: SKY holders can stake their tokens via the SKY Staking Mechanism available on Ethereum Mainnet and SkyLink Deployments. SKY stakers earn voting rewards sourced from the Sky Treasury Management Function. In lieu of USDS rewards, SKY stakers can choose to earn Agent Token Rewards, including SPK and the tokens of other Star Agents incubated by the Launch Project. SKY stakers can also borrow USDS against their staked collateral using the SKY-backed borrowing mechanism defined herein.

711b93cd:dfed3689377817397d2daee88790534.title: Standard Activity Staking Rewards
711b93cd:dfed3689377817397d2daee88790534.content: The Standard Activity Staking Rewards (SASR) is the base reward shared by all wallets with Standard Activity status or higher. When funding is available, the SASR amount is distributed each monthly cycle pro‑rata to the SKY stake of every Standard or High Activity wallet.

711b93cd:f9cb1bf72c34baa363b85da2d713a18.title: Burning of Existing Tokens
711b93cd:f9cb1bf72c34baa363b85da2d713a18.content: At the same time that no new SKY tokens are issued, SKY tokens are bought back and burned on a regular basis, using a portion of the Net Revenue of the Protocol as dictated by the Treasury Management Function. See A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 4: Smart Burn And Standard Activity Staking Rewards - Smart Burn Buffer. As a result, the total supply of SKY tokens will continue to decrease over time.

711b93cd:6a29cdfab859f079bfee76cab4b38ae.title: No New Token Emissions
711b93cd:6a29cdfab859f079bfee76cab4b38ae.content: No new SKY tokens may be emitted except for (1) emissions required to recapitalize the protocol if it is at risk of insolvency (see A.3.7) and (2) temporary emissions that are being deprecated and fully offset by corresponding burns, resulting in no net increase to the intended long-term token supply (see A.4.1 - Core Tokens - SKY - Deprecated Emissions Mechanisms).

711b93cd:f55b2e2516ad444e9cf0e0fef9c1e27.title: Deprecated Emissions Mechanisms
711b93cd:f55b2e2516ad444e9cf0e0fef9c1e27.content: The subdocuments herein define legacy mechanisms involving the issuance of new SKY tokens. Each of these mechanisms is being deprecated. While these mechanisms do not increase the net supply of SKY tokens, they must be replaced with solutions that do not involve any emissions of SKY tokens, as defined in the documents herein.

711b93cd:8e096f853f67e1b3e85305db451caff.title: Initial Token Supply
711b93cd:8e096f853f67e1b3e85305db451caff.content: The initial token supply of SKY tokens is derived from the total number of legacy MKR tokens as of the launch of Sky, multiplied by the conversion ratio of 24,000. SKY is the exclusive governance token of the Sky Protocol and takes over all governance and economic rights previously held by MKR. See A.4.1 - Core Tokens - SKY - MKR To SKY Upgrade Approval.

711b93cd:3f99688ecf247c4be2db3e074a2c578.title: SKY Token Rewards Emissions
711b93cd:3f99688ecf247c4be2db3e074a2c578.content:
USDS users are able to earn SKY Rewards. See A.4.3 - A2 - Savings Rate And Token Reward Mechanism - Token Reward Mechanism. These rewards are currently funded by emissions of new SKY tokens.

These ongoing emissions will be eliminated and replaced with a solution that funds these rewards using SKY held by the Sky Protocol.

At the same time that this new solution is implemented, SKY tokens equal to the total SKY emissions previously used to fund SKY Rewards, including the Early Bird Reward (see A.5.5 - Accessibility Campaigns - Early Bird Reward - Token Distribution), will be burned from SKY held by the Sky Protocol.

The combination of these actions will achieve a state where the number of total SKY tokens is exactly the same as if SKY Rewards had never been funded with protocol emissions.

711b93cd:f6c774566b7008c34e23d5e79fcbd13.title: Deflationary Tokenomics
711b93cd:f6c774566b7008c34e23d5e79fcbd13.content: The documents herein set forth the core deflationary tokenomics of the SKY token.

711b93cd:f977747484c6161df45a61c4092d915.title: MKR To SKY Conversion Emissions
711b93cd:f977747484c6161df45a61c4092d915.content:
The legacy MKR to SKY conversion contract (Legacy Conversion Contract) burns MKR and mints new SKY. The new MKR to SKY conversion contract (New Conversion Contract) instead burns MKR and issues SKY from the existing supply of preminted SKY.

The Legacy Conversion Contract will be disabled as specified in 4.1 - Core Tokens - SKY - Disabling Legacy Conversion Contract. To offset SKY minted by the Legacy Conversion Contract after the deployment of the New Conversion Contract, an equivalent amount of preminted SKY will be burned. This action will ensure the total SKY token supply remains as if these specific emissions from the Legacy Conversion Contract had not occurred.

711b93cd:8f38c99b2ff7bc65290b75e9e11e72f.title: Net Revenue
711b93cd:8f38c99b2ff7bc65290b75e9e11e72f.content: Net Revenue is equal to Income minus Expenses. Income is defined in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 0: Net Revenue - Income. Expenses are defined in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 0: Net Revenue - Expenses. Income and Expenses are defined such that Net Revenue must always be positive.

711b93cd:4a20fea9b55350f384632241d2bba57.title: Step 0: Net Revenue
711b93cd:4a20fea9b55350f384632241d2bba57.content: The sole function of Step 0 is to establish the Net Revenue of the Sky Protocol. It performs no allocations to downstream functions or buffers, unlike subsequent steps for which this Net Revenue serves as the input.

711b93cd:4885672d7a302965a2e0a827a81548d.title: Income
711b93cd:4885672d7a302965a2e0a827a81548d.content: The documents herein define each of the components of the Income of the Sky Protocol. These components are added together to arrive at total Income.

711b93cd:5c9a20ac0192932ef5805678349af21.title: Allocation Steps
711b93cd:5c9a20ac0192932ef5805678349af21.content: The documents herein define the allocation steps of the Sky Treasury Management Function. The process is divided into steps beginning with Net Revenue. These steps form a “waterfall” with each previous step needing to be fully funded before any funds can be allocated to later steps.

711b93cd:8f4f224b47722710ac5c9878c8f7597.title: Stability Fees From Base Rate
711b93cd:8f4f224b47722710ac5c9878c8f7597.content: Stability Fees are the fees that Sky Core charges Star Agents to borrow from Sky. See A.3.2 - Core Stability Parameters - Parameters - Base Rate. Sky Core’s legacy ALM infrastructure is currently being transferred to Star Agents; during this transition period and until this transfer is fully complete, income generated from the Sky Core Collateral Portfolio contributes to net revenue. See A.3.4 - Application To Sky Core.

711b93cd:8eb274e094519504cf6ca26c4f14496.title: Integration With Monthly Settlement Cycle
711b93cd:8eb274e094519504cf6ca26c4f14496.content: The Sky Treasury Management Function is synchronized with the Monthly Settlement Cycle. See A.2.6. At the conclusion of each MSC, the Net Revenue of the Sky Protocol for the preceding month is calculated and allocated according to the waterfall process defined in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps.

711b93cd:169e81cfef5073c0741b0a82209c934.title: Internal Senior Risk Capital Income
711b93cd:169e81cfef5073c0741b0a82209c934.content: Internal Senior Risk Capital income is the revenue attributed to Sky from the total payments made by Stars for Originated Senior Risk Capital (OSRC). ISRC itself comprises surplus capital allocated from designated buffers funded by the Sky Treasury Management Function. While Stars pay a single clearing price for their OSRC based on the monthly Origination Process, the total revenue received by Sky is subsequently allocated proportionally, with the portion corresponding to ISRC’s share of the Total Senior Risk Capital (TSRC) pool designated as ISRC Income. See A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Sourcing Of Internal Senior Risk Capital From Surplus Buffers.

711b93cd:98aba395ec57913052bf359d5746082.title: Step 1: Security and Stability Maintenance
711b93cd:98aba395ec57913052bf359d5746082.content: All of the Net Revenue from Step 0 (A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 0: Net Revenue) becomes Step 1 Capital. 10% of Step 1 Capital is allocated for security and stability maintenance as specified in the documents herein. The remaining 90% of Step 1 Capital becomes Step 2 Capital and is allocated as specified in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards.

711b93cd:ca235b13a8aa53c42d23e62d6f0bb12.title: Pioneer Rewards
711b93cd:ca235b13a8aa53c42d23e62d6f0bb12.content: Pioneer Rewards are paid to Pioneer Stars as specified in A.2.4 - Pioneer Incentive Pool.

711b93cd:7812badcb556e289ab2c0592a6a82f5.title: Core Executor Budget
711b93cd:7812badcb556e289ab2c0592a6a82f5.content: Up to 5% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to the Core Executor Budget. This budget funds active Core Executor Agents responsible for the continuous improvement of the Atlas, including the risk management framework and other critical components.

711b93cd:bf6da553a8e91db0fa407f3d5d5dc1b.title: Reimbursement Rewards
711b93cd:bf6da553a8e91db0fa407f3d5d5dc1b.content: Reimbursement Rewards are paid to Star Agents to reimburse them for the costs of building common infrastructure used by the entire Sky Ecosystem, such as Token SkyLink deployments.

711b93cd:b878890b00204d2f2603a10a7952cb4.title: Voluntary Reduction By Core Executor Agents
711b93cd:b878890b00204d2f2603a10a7952cb4.content: Core Executor Agents may agree to voluntarily reduce their budget below 5% when applying for a Core Executor Slot in order to increase their chances of being elected to a Core Executor Slot. To the extent that Core Executor Agents reduce their budget, Step 2 Capital is increased by a corresponding amount. The mechanism by which Core Executor Agents are elected will be specified in a future iteration of the Atlas.

711b93cd:ba01649ce174f4d4bb89901c1329e4a.title: Accessibility Rewards
711b93cd:ba01649ce174f4d4bb89901c1329e4a.content: The Accessibility Reward is paid to Star Agents and third-party partners that drive adoption of USDS. See A.2.4 - Accessibility Reward Primitive.

711b93cd:f87db0179f29176a8dcf34cc92139e4.title: Core Executor Reward
711b93cd:f87db0179f29176a8dcf34cc92139e4.content: Up to 3% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to Core Executors whose terms have ended in the last four (4) years. This incentivizes Core Executors to increase the long term profitability of the Sky Ecosystem during their Core Executor Slot terms, as the Core Executor Reward is a percentage of future Net Revenue.

711b93cd:baca4f85ec292adc80d6de38e1d8384.title: Agent Token Distribution Voting Rewards
711b93cd:baca4f85ec292adc80d6de38e1d8384.content: SKY stakers are eligible to receive Agent Token rewards as specified in A.4.5. At the Monthly Settlement Cycle, Agent Tokens are distributed pro‑rata, by staked SKY, among wallets that have opted to receive a specific Agent Token for the cycle. To qualify for Agent Token payout a wallet must satisfy the Standard Activity criteria specified in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 4: Smart Burn And Standard Activity Staking Rewards - Standard Activity Staking Rewards - Payout From Standard Activity Staking Rewards Buffer.

9eedc5bc:eab32b6137d5f58fff51a9eed8aee3a.title: Governance Accessibility Rewards Paid To Prime Agents
9eedc5bc:eab32b6137d5f58fff51a9eed8aee3a.content: 0.5% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to Prime Agents that manage the rewards for Governance Integrators, incentivizing the active participation of Prime Agents. See A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 1: Security and Stability Maintenance - Governance Accessibility Rewards Paid To Integrators.

9eedc5bc:f95d85532de23b1c9c2a29a71599e7d.title: Governance Accessibility Rewards Paid To Integrators
9eedc5bc:f95d85532de23b1c9c2a29a71599e7d.content: 0.5% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to frontends and other Integrators that facilitate accessible governance, following security and information standards specified in the Atlas. These standards will be specified in a future iteration of the Atlas. See A.2.4 - Core Governance Reward Primitive.

9eedc5bc:9f3eef5c1781c063ad161e7e4db7fd3.title: Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards
9eedc5bc:9f3eef5c1781c063ad161e7e4db7fd3.content: 5% of the Step 2 Capital is allocated to High Activity Staking Rewards (”HASR”) as specified in the documents herein. The remaining 95% of Step 2 Capital becomes Step 3 Capital.

9eedc5bc:dcc71e080c0f5a97b84b59ab85176c9.title: Voluntary Reduction By Aligned Delegates
9eedc5bc:dcc71e080c0f5a97b84b59ab85176c9.content: Aligned Delegates may agree to voluntarily reduce their compensation in order to incentivize SKY holders to delegate to them. To the extent that Aligned Delegates reduce their compensation, Step 2 Capital is increased by a corresponding amount. The mechanism by which Aligned Delegates may agree to reduce their compensation will be specified in a future iteration of the Atlas.

9eedc5bc:20bf8eeb257dfc45f2e3da9373f3070.title: Purpose
9eedc5bc:20bf8eeb257dfc45f2e3da9373f3070.content: High Activity Staking Rewards provide a boosted staking reward to SKY stakers that delegate their SKY through compliant Governance Accessibility frontends and provide feedback to their delegates every three (3) months. This ensures that there is a minimum amount of SKY that is always actively following current events and governance to detect potential misalignment or buildup of hidden risks.

9eedc5bc:189c5bcbb7ac8afbe12e1f40865c137.title: Aligned Delegates
9eedc5bc:189c5bcbb7ac8afbe12e1f40865c137.content: Up to 1% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to Aligned Delegates.

9eedc5bc:f00f2441e3d63b99815b2cb90b7c2e5.title: Funding Of High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer
9eedc5bc:f00f2441e3d63b99815b2cb90b7c2e5.content: 5% of the Step 2 Capital is allocated to funding the High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer (HASRB) linearly over the course of the month. 711b93cd:668974d93c7d3b4c9e6dbf81d48f025.title: Recourse
711b93cd:668974d93c7d3b4c9e6dbf81d48f025.content: Sky's recourse for bad debt consists of (1) minting Star Agent tokens; (2) terminating a Star's right to further borrowing; and (3) activation of the Resolution Mechanism which includes, without limitation, the authority to suspend all protocol operations, seize or reallocate all of the Star assets, override or disable smart contract functions, initiate managed restructuring, or execute full and permanent liquidation of the affected sub-protocol and all of its assets, in order to contain risk and preserve the stability and solvency of the broader ecosystem.

711b93cd:3f636560870e3e6745e1e0a2f39bcd8.title: Star Agent
711b93cd:3f636560870e3e6745e1e0a2f39bcd8.content:
Star Agents maintain and automate Sky features in new markets, and innovate custom products. Star Agents are the only Agent type that can access all Sky Primitives; whereas Executor Agents are limited in the Primitives they can access.

-   Star Agents cannot directly operationalize those elements of their strategies that directly interface with the Sky Protocol or shared ecosystem infrastructure. For such protocol-level and ecosystem-critical operations, Star Agents must rely on Operational Executor Agents for implementation.
-   When a Star Agent formulates a new initiative, it encodes the relevant instructions and parameters into its Agent Artifact. Insofar as the Star Agent's Artifact requires protocol-level interactions, the Operational Executors use the Artifact as a detailed operational blueprint for implementing the Star Agent's directives-ensuring consistency with the Atlas and minimizing risk.
-   This ensures a robust division between Star Agents' strategic, externally facing activities and the specialized operational activities that directly interface with Sky's core systems.

711b93cd:1e5cf237dede0e5b10736959fa62a4e.title: Agent Scope
711b93cd:1e5cf237dede0e5b10736959fa62a4e.content: The Agent Scope codifies all Agent Artifacts.

711b93cd:0e505e77938e140afb8c4e0d7f9f8e4.title: Executor Agent
711b93cd:0e505e77938e140afb8c4e0d7f9f8e4.content:
Executor Agents ("Executors") are specialized Agents that implement those elements of a Star Agent's activities that directly interface with the Sky Protocol or shared ecosystem resources, leaving Star Agents free to focus on strategic, business development, and marketing efforts. There are two Executor sub-types: Core Executor Agents ("Core Executors") and Operational Executor Agents ("Operational Executors").

-   Operational Executor Agents handle the day-to-day execution of those portions of a Star Agent's strategies that directly interface with the Sky Protocol, strictly following the instructions laid out in each Star Agent's Artifact. Star Agents cannot be active in the Sky Ecosystem unless they have an active "Operational Executor Accord" which codifies their relationship with an Operational Executor. Operational Executors take on the risk of Star Agents' outcomes by providing collateralized insurance against losses or liabilities. Operational Executor Agents' Operational Collateral can also cover losses from negligence or malicious behavior by the Operational Executor in carrying out the Star Agent's strategy.
-   Core Executors, on the other hand, oversee the activities of Operational Executors, ensuring that the implementation of Star Agent strategies aligns with the Atlas.
-   By separating strategy from operations, this division of labor empowers Star Agents to innovate rapidly and expand their ventures without needing to develop specialized operational expertise, as Operational Executors manage the day-to-day technical implementation under Core Executor oversight.

711b93cd:d6d04926fcd95025facf419b646c219.title: Agent Artifact
711b93cd:d6d04926fcd95025facf419b646c219.content: Agent Artifacts contain all rules, processes, parameters, and knowledge of the Agent. Agent Artifacts must be aligned with, and are fully subordinate to, the Sky Core Atlas.

711b93cd:af1edc1e3b32c1b730264a13bd5baf1.title: Operational Executor Agent
711b93cd:af1edc1e3b32c1b730264a13bd5baf1.content:
Operational Executor Agents ("Operational Executors") are specialized Executor Agents tasked with implementing and verifying those elements of a Star Agent's strategy that directly interface with the Sky Protocol or shared ecosystem resources. While Star Agents autonomously set strategic direction, Operational Executors are responsible for operationalizing those activities that modify on-chain or protocol-level state, relying on the relevant Primitive Configuration Documents in the Agent Artifact.

Each Operational Executor Agent must comprise at least one Facilitator and at least one GovOps actor. Facilitators are responsible for interpreting the Atlas and the Agent Artifact and instructing GovOps actors to carry out the corresponding actions. To ensure accountability and mitigate potential risks, Operational Executor Agents must maintain Operational Collateral, which serves as a guarantee to cover losses or damages resulting from negligence or malicious behavior by either Facilitators or GovOps actors.

711b93cd:1e904f6db76885515882634f4423e5b.title: Agent
711b93cd:1e904f6db76885515882634f4423e5b.content: Agents are first-class economic citizens of Sky that autonomously pursue business opportunities. Each Agent has its own Agent Artifact and token. Initially, the creation of an Agent results in a Proto-Agent, which lacks any specialized role. To gain functionality within the Sky ecosystem, a Proto-Agent must deploy a special Transformation Primitive to transform into a specific Agent sub-type. The Agent sub-types currently defined in the Atlas include 1) Star Agent and 2) Executor Agent, with the Executor Agent sub-type further divided into Operational Executor Agents and Core Executor Agents. Although Executor Agents are not yet operational, the Atlas nonetheless defines the foundational rules, processes, and governance structures necessary for their eventual activation. In the medium to long term, these Executor Agents will become fully operative and perform an essential function in facilitating the activities of Star Agents across the Sky ecosystem.

711b93cd:bb26e11e6fa0ff5e19a94895f27d236.title: Core Executor Agent
711b93cd:bb26e11e6fa0ff5e19a94895f27d236.content: Core Executor Agents ("Core Executors") are Executor Agents that serve as checks on Operational Executor Agents.

711b93cd:06fd93b7ba00b8f3a8bd5332a99b9a0.title: GovOps
711b93cd:06fd93b7ba00b8f3a8bd5332a99b9a0.content: Governance Operations ("GovOps") actors are specialized Ecosystem Actors operating within Executor Agent entities. They manage the technical implementation of Star Agents' Instances of Sky Primitives by carrying out on-chain/off-chain tasks necessary for Star Agents' operational and governance processes. They work in tandem with Executor Facilitators, who interpret the Atlas and the Agent Artifact.

711b93cd:a37e39ff0f02bc1c590532eb9c5f257.title: Operational Executor GovOps
711b93cd:a37e39ff0f02bc1c590532eb9c5f257.content: Operational Executor GovOps ("Operational GovOps") actors are GovOps actors that operate within Operational Executor Agents. Operational GovOps play a crucial role in implementing Star Agent strategies, doing so by executing the technical specifications outlined in Primitive Configuration Documents of Agent Artifacts.

711b93cd:1f829fe0de7cb54dbb04c1ecd82beaf.title: Sky Ecosystem Liquidity Bootstrapping
711b93cd:1f829fe0de7cb54dbb04c1ecd82beaf.content:
The Accessibility Facilitators must work with advisors and Ecosystem Actors to implement a liquidity bootstrapping program using up to 20 million USDS and 320 million SKY. These assets can be used for liquidity programs, or for liquidity infrastructure integration costs. Anything leftover from usage in liquidity programs must be returned to Sky control at the end of the bootstrapping program.
The funds can be paid into multisig accounts for future use via executive votes at will by the Accessibility Facilitators.

711b93cd:d0aaa3f57942e1a02a2af55932fbbdf.title: Sky on Solana Short Term Crosschain Strategy
711b93cd:d0aaa3f57942e1a02a2af55932fbbdf.content:
The Accessibility Facilitators must work with Advisors and Ecosystem Actors to research and implement a decentralized crosschain solution using Wormhole that enables the bridging of USDS to Solana.
Once the crosschain solution is implemented, the Accessibility Facilitators must use the USDS integration boost system to encourage integration and adoption of USDS on Solana.

711b93cd:89693461c3f33ad3b8b6a139cbbfb34.title: The Type Specification Type
711b93cd:89693461c3f33ad3b8b6a139cbbfb34.content:
The Type Specification Type is used for Type Specification Documents that specify the characteristics of each of the different Document Types. It ensures that all Type Specifications contain all necessary information to make it easy to reason about whether a document follows the requirements for its type.

"Type Name": The Type Name Component must contain the name of the Document Type"Type Overview": The Type Overview Component must contain high level information as human-readable text about the type, such as what it is used for and why it is necessary."Type Components": If the Type has Components, they must be specified in this Component as a nested object."Type Category": This Component must specify whether the Type is an Immutable Document, a Primary Document, a Supporting Document, or a Translation Document."Document Identifier Rules": This Component must specify as human-readable text rules related to the Document Identifier for Atlas Documents of this Type, and their locations in the Document Trees."Additional Logic": This Component can contain additional logic that applies to all Documents of the Type.

Primary Document

Type Specification Documents must follow the Document Identifier rules for Primary Documents.

The rules specified in Type Specification Documents must be followed for all Atlas Documents.
ancestors: Structure, Categories, And Types Of Atlas Documents

711b93cd:2e243c6cde1450234ff244c14b855af.title: The Atlas Preamble Type
711b93cd:2e243c6cde1450234ff244c14b855af.content:
The Atlas Preamble Type is used for the Atlas Preamble Document Tree which starts at the 0th position of the first layer of the Atlas. The Atlas Preamble details the Spirit of the Atlas in human-readable language, and specifies important definitions for understanding the Spirit of the Atlas, that must be used as context when interpreting all other parts of the Atlas.

"Content": The content Component is very flexible and defines in broad human-readable language the Spirit of the Atlas.

Immutable Document

Atlas Preamble Documents are located at A.0 or as nested Documents one layer below A.0.

Atlas Preamble Documents are immutable, foundational parts of the Atlas and their content must be considered when interpreting all other Atlas Documents.
ancestors: Structure, Categories, And Types Of Atlas Documents

711b93cd:130c4becd94740adb320f0a9579bfe0.title: The Scope Type
711b93cd:130c4becd94740adb320f0a9579bfe0.content:
The Scope Type is used for the six nonzero Immutable Documents of the first layer of the Atlas that directly describe focus areas, principles, rules and processes of Sky Governance. Scope Documents define the broad boundaries, requirements and objectives of each of the six Atlas Scopes, so that they together can fully cover all activities that are needed for Sky to function while maintaining its resilient equilibrium.

"Content": The content Component is very flexible and defines in broad human-readable language core principles, rules and processes.

Immutable Document

Scope Documents have the Document Identifiers from A.1 to A.6.

Scope Documents are immutable, foundational parts of the Atlas and their content must be considered when interpreting all principles, rules and processes of Atlas Documents nested below them
ancestors: Structure, Categories, And Types Of Atlas Documents

711b93cd:00a43f97af3a2447531db46311420d6.title: Unrewarded USDS
711b93cd:00a43f97af3a2447531db46311420d6.content: Unrewarded USDS are USDS balances that are not receiving the Sky Savings Rate, Integration Boost or USDS Token Rewards. USDS Token Rewards include both SKY and Agent token rewards.

711b93cd:09cae1f8a90ae34096284c9142741c0.title: stUSDS
711b93cd:09cae1f8a90ae34096284c9142741c0.content: The token used to provide the capital for SKY Staking leverage is called stUSDS. It ensures that all SKY-backed borrowing is funded by segregated risk capital. Users can deposit USDS into a smart contract and receive stUSDS, which can later be converted back to USDS as long as there is unutilized USDS in the stUSDS converter smart contract.

711b93cd:14dd50750354651e2ba0864ca4ffb3c.title: Introduction
711b93cd:14dd50750354651e2ba0864ca4ffb3c.content: Launch Agent 2 is an Agent dedicated to expanding access to USDS, sUSDS, and other Sky benefits with an initial focus on the Solana ecosystem. Launch Agent 2 leverages strategic incentives and partnerships to foster adoption, deliver the Sky Savings Rate, and bring USDS liquidity to new markets. Launch Agent 2 also identifies and executes allocation opportunities to generate excess returns on assets in Sky's collateral portfolio. Launch Agent 2 plans to develop a user-facing DeFi hub as well as other products that align naturally with Launch Agent 2's existing capabilities, including borrowing and lending solutions.

711b93cd:7abfb6608f19a2d99d554a87fc7daa2.title: Introduction
711b93cd:7abfb6608f19a2d99d554a87fc7daa2.content: Launch Agent 3 is an Agent specializing in creating accessible and user-friendly DeFi interfaces. It operates the Launch Agent 3 Frontend user interface. Launch Agent 3 Frontend is a non-custodial web application serving as a gateway to the Sky Protocol. Through its AI-powered interface, Launch Agent 3 Frontend makes digital asset interactions intuitive and accessible for users of all experience levels-all while ensuring users maintain complete control of their assets. Launch Agent 3 Frontend never takes custody of users' private keys or assets; users retain full responsibility for managing their private keys and digital wallet access.

237129ca:cbb91c2328f12036d1b6c42a7f1ef1b.title: yUSDS Holders' Risk Bearing
237129ca:cbb91c2328f12036d1b6c42a7f1ef1b.content: Holders of yUSDS accept the risk associated with providing capital for SKY-backed borrowing. In the event that the liquidation of a borrower's staked SKY collateral does not cover the outstanding debt, yUSDS balances will be subject to a haircut proportional to the shortfall. This mechanism ensures that the Sky Protocol is isolated from losses originating from the SKY-backed borrowing facility.

237129ca:f69ad13f322092589b01a2851a46570.title: yUSDS Accessibility Reward Definition
237129ca:f69ad13f322092589b01a2851a46570.content: yUSDS Accessibility Reward is defined in A.4.4 - SKY Staking Mechanism - SKY Staking - SKY-Backed Borrowing - yUSDS Accessibility Reward.

237129ca:833b7dfe2718806945a15c69e35252a.title: Debt Ceiling
237129ca:833b7dfe2718806945a15c69e35252a.content: The maximum amount of USDS that can be borrowed against staked SKY is dynamically determined by, and equal to, the total amount of USDS currently held within the yUSDS contract. This dynamic ceiling will replace the static DC-IAM module and parameters associated with protocol-dependent, SKY-backed borrowing.

237129ca:f7fbf980513fbf2b5f83aa8e87a804a.title: Sky Savings Rate Definition
237129ca:f7fbf980513fbf2b5f83aa8e87a804a.content: Sky Savings Rate is the Sky Savings Rate defined in A.3.2 - Core Stability Parameters - Parameters - Sky Savings Rate.

237129ca:c2e76025dcb7b1671391f16c309fd30.title: SKY Borrow Rate
237129ca:c2e76025dcb7b1671391f16c309fd30.content: The interest rate charged to borrowers (SKY Borrow Rate) is dynamic and market-driven, based on the utilization of funds within the yUSDS contract. This dynamic rate will replace the static Stability Fee parameter associated with protocol-dependent, SKY-backed borrowing.

237129ca:29afc3fb3a8285dfc02798691898a6f.title: SKY Borrow Rate Definition
237129ca:29afc3fb3a8285dfc02798691898a6f.content: SKY Borrow Rate is the SKY Borrow Rate defined in A.4.4 - SKY Staking Mechanism - SKY Staking - SKY-Backed Borrowing - SKY Borrow Rate.

237129ca:e7a8886de5c42fe36f3385bfecf197f.title: Rate Setting Mechanism
237129ca:e7a8886de5c42fe36f3385bfecf197f.content:
The SKY Borrow Rate adjusts to target a 90% utilization rate of the USDS in the yUSDS contract. When yUSDS utilization is below 90%, the rate gradually decreases; when above 90%, it gradually increases. The SKY Borrow Rate cannot fall below the SKY Borrow Minimum Rate. See A.4.4 - SKY Staking Mechanism - SKY Staking - SKY-Backed Borrowing - SKY Borrow Rate - SKY Borrow Minimum Rate.
The specific parameters and formula governing the rate of adjustment will be specified in a future iteration of the Atlas.

237129ca:96d4e7d7a8ee7523f88d3463dec6623.title: yUSDS Accessibility Reward
237129ca:96d4e7d7a8ee7523f88d3463dec6623.content: The yUSDS Accessibility Reward is an incentive mechanism, similar to the USDS Accessibility Reward, designed to encourage Star Agents and Integrators to promote yUSDS adoption. See A.2.4 - Accessibility Reward Primitive. It is calculated as a percentage of the yUSDS balance associated with a Reward Code. The reward is initially set at 0.05% for the Integrator portion and 0.05% for the Star Agent Management Fee, totaling 0.1%.

237129ca:bc97c3653e4754031a5e1f5dcffcd9a.title: SKY Borrow Minimum Rate
237129ca:bc97c3653e4754031a5e1f5dcffcd9a.content:
The SKY Borrow Minimum Rate is calculated according to the following formula:

```

            SKY Borrow Minimum Rate = Sky Savings Rate + yUSDS Accessibility Reward
```

The formula ensures the SKY Borrow Minimum Rate covers the baseline cost of capital (Sky Savings Rate) plus the incentive cost (yUSDS Accessibility Reward), preventing value-draining arbitrage where users could borrow below the Sky Savings Rate.

237129ca:5b7bfa344c372a0cc0a09c2544a1970.title: Short Term Transitionary Measures
237129ca:5b7bfa344c372a0cc0a09c2544a1970.content: The documents herein define short-term logic for SKY staking rewards and SKY-backed borrowing pending the implementation of the Sky Treasury Management Function and the yUSDS system. Short-term logic regarding MKR staking rewards and MKR-backed borrowing is also included herein.

237129ca:a4b7dabd0349cf82eb3b2b6b49a71a3.title: Parameters Definition
237129ca:a4b7dabd0349cf82eb3b2b6b49a71a3.content: The parameters of the yUSDS Rate formula are further defined in the documents herein.

237129ca:5c606deb2da0e6bd78199ba1e7717aa.title: yUSDS Rate
237129ca:5c606deb2da0e6bd78199ba1e7717aa.content:
The variable yield earned by yUSDS holders is calculated using the formula:

```

            yUSDS Rate = Utilization * (SKY Borrow Rate - yUSDS Accessibility Reward) + (1 - Utilization) * Sky Savings Rate
```

Depositors earn a rate derived from the SKY Borrow Rate less the yUSDS Accessibility Reward on the utilized portion of their capital and the Sky Savings Rate on the unutilized portion.

237129ca:0acdb0f8d5bff6c1142341dc869d7df.title: yUSDS Function
237129ca:0acdb0f8d5bff6c1142341dc869d7df.content: yUSDS is a yield-bearing token representing USDS deposited into the yUSDS contract. Its primary function is to provide segregated risk capital for the SKY-backed borrowing mechanism. Users convert USDS to yUSDS to provide this capital and earn the yUSDS Rate. See A.4.4 - SKY Staking Mechanism - SKY Staking - SKY-Backed Borrowing - yUSDS Rate. yUSDS can be converted back to USDS subject to available unutilized liquidity in the yUSDS converter contract.

237129ca:772c20171e3c6435faed9ca800ef758.title: SKY-Backed Borrowing
237129ca:772c20171e3c6435faed9ca800ef758.content: SKY stakers can borrow USDS against their staked SKY collateral. This borrowing will be facilitated exclusively by the yUSDS system which will provide protocol-independent, or segregated, risk capital. The yUSDS system is currently in development; its elements are outlined in the subdocuments below. During the transition period to the yUSDS system, the protocol-dependent SKY-backed borrowing system remains operational and is governed by A.4.4 - SKY Staking Mechanism - SKY Staking - Short Term Transitionary Measures.

237129ca:baca4f85ec292adc80d6de38e1d8384.title: Agent Token Distribution Voting Rewards
237129ca:baca4f85ec292adc80d6de38e1d8384.content: SKY stakers are eligible to receive Agent Token rewards as specified in A.4.5. At the Monthly Settlement Cycle, Agent Tokens are distributed pro‑rata, by staked SKY, among wallets that have opted to receive a specific Agent Token for the cycle. To qualify for Agent Token payout a wallet must satisfy the Standard Activity criteria specified in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 4: Smart Burn And Standard Activity Staking Rewards - Standard Activity Staking Rewards - Payout From Standard Activity Staking Rewards Buffer.

237129ca:dfed3689377817397d2daee88790534.title: Standard Activity Staking Rewards
237129ca:dfed3689377817397d2daee88790534.content: The Standard Activity Staking Rewards (SASR) is the base reward shared by all wallets with Standard Activity status or higher. When funding is available, the SASR amount is distributed each monthly cycle pro‑rata to the SKY stake of every Standard or High Activity wallet.

237129ca:14629e34d62c931a9f40a4d9305ad3b.title: High Activity Staking Rewards
237129ca:14629e34d62c931a9f40a4d9305ad3b.content: The High Activity Staking Rewards (HASR) is a boosted reward provided to High Activity wallets. The HASR amount is distributed each monthly cycle pro-rata to the SKY stake of all High Activity wallets. High Activity wallets receive SASR (when funding is available) plus their separate HASR boost.

704f0378:4f1b502dda6b0bc3eefc55492729b59.title: Utilization Definition
704f0378:4f1b502dda6b0bc3eefc55492729b59.content: Utilization is the percent of funds in the stUSDS contract that are used to fund borrowing against staked SKY.

237129ca:e27b09e01a90b6fafa30559619ad44b.title: Actively Stabilizing Collateral Calculations

237129ca:dc4946cb08d8372e075bccda0aa1dc7.title: Actively Stabilizing Collateral
237129ca:dc4946cb08d8372e075bccda0aa1dc7.content: Actively Stabilizing Collateral must provide buy support at a price of at least 0.999 USD per USDS (10bps downside spread). Actively Stabilizing Collateral includes cash stablecoins (e.g., USDC, USDT) in PSMs or decentralized exchanges (e.g., Curve), other stablecoins, crypto assets, or off-chain Real World Asset (RWA) loans to market makers, provided they meet the specified redemption price and transparency requirements.

237129ca:3f3054ce80eb86a1c97d78bfa0fa943.title: Penalties For Failing To Satisfy Actively Stabilizing Collateral Requirement
237129ca:3f3054ce80eb86a1c97d78bfa0fa943.content: If a Star Agent does not maintain the Minimum Actively Stabilizing Collateral, it will continuously be penalized at a rate of 200% APY on the missing Actively Stabilizing Collateral. This penalty is calculated retroactively per second and settled monthly during the Settlement Cycle.

237129ca:15cfc19295d648918d9df7bc711afb4.title: Minimum Actively Stabilizing Collateral
237129ca:15cfc19295d648918d9df7bc711afb4.content: Star Agents must maintain at least 20% of their Collateral Portfolio in Actively Stabilizing Collateral.

237129ca:8a970ec69d49269ae3bdece303b38d7.title: Minimum Demand Absorption Buffer
237129ca:8a970ec69d49269ae3bdece303b38d7.content: Every Star Agent must maintain a Demand Absorption Buffer equal to 25% of their required Actively Stabilizing Collateral.

237129ca:76efd084a79031c231a654af435f4c1.title: Low Risk Real World Assets
237129ca:76efd084a79031c231a654af435f4c1.content: Low Risk RWAs ("LRR") are safe, short-term treasury strategies of less than one (1) year duration.

237129ca:091646af52289515247dc47b2af6bbe.title: Demand Absorption Buffer
237129ca:091646af52289515247dc47b2af6bbe.content: To further stabilize USDS during periods of excess supply, Star Agents must maintain a Demand Absorption Buffer (DAB), a subset of ASC consisting of USDS that is for sale for at most 1.001 USD per USDS. The Demand Absorption Buffer includes USDS or DAI in PSMs. The Demand Absorption Buffer can also be fulfilled by autonomous systems that generate USDS dynamically through the allocation as needed.

704f0378:26bb89ccbb8d9062cb619e58a141f6a.title: Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral Calculations

704f0378:8ed8a3bf700e4c6ebbc1b4f7617ccbe.title: Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral
704f0378:8ed8a3bf700e4c6ebbc1b4f7617ccbe.content: Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral must provide buy support at a price of at least 0.999 USD per USDS (10bps downside spread). Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral includes cash stablecoins (e.g., USDC, USDT) in PSMs or decentralized exchanges (e.g., Curve), other stablecoins, crypto assets, or off-chain Real World Asset (RWA) loans to market makers, provided they meet the specified redemption price and transparency requirements.

704f0378:b2c619ee4edebe07537247c76367df4.title: Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral
704f0378:b2c619ee4edebe07537247c76367df4.content:
Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral consists of cash stablecoins that do not qualify as Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral but can be converted to Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral. Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral may include cash stablecoins deposited into lending protocols, cash stablecoins used to provide liquidity to decentralized exchanges, or liquid staking derivatives of cash stablecoins.

Assets must satisfy the following requirements to qualify as Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral:

1.  The assets must be verifiable onchain or through reputable APIs or oracles;
2.  The assets must be able to be converted into Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral within 15 minutes under normal market conditions; and
3.  The process to convert the assets into Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral must be fully automated and triggered automatically when ASC falls below specified levels.

704f0378:c3363d1f09e30e5803cf41b25447299.title: Actively Stabilizing Collateral
704f0378:c3363d1f09e30e5803cf41b25447299.content: Actively Stabilizing Collateral is the sum of (1) Resting Actively Stabilizing Collateral and (2) Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral.

704f0378:997ae266f8c92662080fec93dfac5c7.title: Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral Calculations

704f0378:a36a142ae3d15c0d70620768f227f70.title: Minimum Actively Stabilizing Collateral
704f0378:a36a142ae3d15c0d70620768f227f70.content: Star Agents must maintain at least 25% of their Collateral Portfolio in Actively Stabilizing Collateral.

704f0378:570bdfcc0893da4ed462e486e7c5e97.title: Maximum Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral
704f0378:570bdfcc0893da4ed462e486e7c5e97.content: Latent Actively Stabilizing Collateral may not exceed 25% of Actively Stabilizing Collateral.

237129ca:4acf9807ae60bc5d06fa17967e3b383.title: yUSDS
237129ca:4acf9807ae60bc5d06fa17967e3b383.content: The token used to provide the capital for SKY Staking leverage is called yUSDS. It ensures that all SKY-backed borrowing is funded by segregated risk capital. Users can deposit USDS into a smart contract and receive yUSDS, which can later be converted back to USDS as long as there is unutilized USDS in the yUSDS converter smart contract.

237129ca:ae1be3b46c978a1b11e3a6d38907e33.title: Voting Power
237129ca:ae1be3b46c978a1b11e3a6d38907e33.content: "Voting Power" denotes the ability of Aligned Delegates to vote on Sky governance decisions on behalf of a SKY holder. SKY holders can delegate their Voting Power to an Aligned Delegate through Delegate Contracts, allowing the Aligned Delegate to vote on their behalf while the SKY holders retain control of their tokens.

237129ca:00a43f97af3a2447531db46311420d6.title: Unrewarded USDS
237129ca:00a43f97af3a2447531db46311420d6.content: Unrewarded USDS are USDS balances that are not receiving the Sky Savings Rate, Integration Boost or USDS Token Rewards. USDS Token Rewards include both SKY and Agent token rewards.

237129ca:1e904f6db76885515882634f4423e5b.title: Agent
237129ca:1e904f6db76885515882634f4423e5b.content: Agents are first-class economic citizens of Sky that autonomously pursue business opportunities. Each Agent has its own Agent Artifact and token. Initially, the creation of an Agent results in a Proto-Agent, which lacks any specialized role. To gain functionality within the Sky ecosystem, a Proto-Agent must deploy a special Transformation Primitive to transform into a specific Agent sub-type. The Agent sub-types currently defined in the Atlas include 1) Star Agent and 2) Executor Agent, with the Executor Agent sub-type further divided into Operational Executor Agents and Core Executor Agents. Although Executor Agents are not yet operational, the Atlas nonetheless defines the foundational rules, processes, and governance structures necessary for their eventual activation. In the medium to long term, these Executor Agents will become fully operative and perform an essential function in facilitating the activities of Star Agents across the Sky ecosystem.

237129ca:c2564e235b94ac9dbed0435484b54a4.title: Skylink
237129ca:c2564e235b94ac9dbed0435484b54a4.content: Skylink is the Sky Ecosystem's multichain solution, connecting USDS, SKY and other Sky Ecosystem tokens from the Ethereum Mainnet to other chains and L2 protocols. Skylink will make all core Sky features available on the chains and L2s it is deployed to, including Native USDS; Native Sky Savings Rate; Native Token Rewards and Native 1:1 conversion between USDC and USDS.

237129ca:c4aa49392006ad0c0d9e709f40dfe28.title: Distribution Requirement Primitive
237129ca:c4aa49392006ad0c0d9e709f40dfe28.content:
The Distribution Requirement Primitive requires Agents to periodically buy and distribute 0.25% of their token supply per year. The annual requirement of 0.25% of the token supply is divided into twelve (12) equal monthly distributions. Distributions must occur on the first day of each month, with tokens purchased by the Star Agent on the open market and transferred to an address designated by Sky Core in A.2.4 - Sky Core-Designated Address.

Star Agents choose between fulfilling either the Distribution Requirement Primitive or the Market Cap Fee Primitive.

237129ca:7bc7fcdecbd2b1baea630e66128565b.title: Calculation of Distributed Tokens
237129ca:7bc7fcdecbd2b1baea630e66128565b.content: The value of the distributed tokens is calculated as the number of tokens distributed, multiplied by the Time-Weighted Average Price (TWAP) of the token over the 24-hour period ending at 23:59 UTC on the last day of each month, immediately preceding the distribution event. This value is applied in the rebate calculation under the Upkeep Rebate Primitive. See A.2.4 - Upkeep Rebate Primitive.

237129ca:ed66bf9ce5280f6aa2f5eae9d1a064a.title: Ecosystem Upkeep Primitives
237129ca:ed66bf9ce5280f6aa2f5eae9d1a064a.content: Ecosystem Upkeep Primitives ensure that all Agents contribute to long-term ecosystem sustainability. Star Agents must choose between either the Distribution Requirement Primitive or the Market Cap Fee Primitive; whereas the Upkeep Rebate Primitive applies universally to all Star Agents. The term "Ecosystem Upkeep Fees" refers to the upkeep obligation of a Star Agent pursuant to either the Distribution Requirement Primitive or the Market Cap Fee Primitive.

237129ca:a07c896328523c4997e7f3b0accb6a7.title: Market Cap Fee Primitive
237129ca:a07c896328523c4997e7f3b0accb6a7.content:
The Market Cap Fee Primitive requires Star Agents to pay an annual fee equivalent to 0.30% of their market capitalization to Sky, accounted for monthly. The annual fee of 0.30% of the market capitalization is divided into twelve (12) equal monthly payments, equating to 0.025% of the market capitalization per month. Payments must occur on the first day of each month, with the fee transferred to an address designated by Sky Core in A.2.4 - Sky Core-Designated Address.

Star Agents choose between fulfilling either the Distribution Requirement Primitive or the Market Cap Fee Primitive.

237129ca:6cd403525dc9b175ba29c8279d1962d.title: Light Agent Primitive
237129ca:6cd403525dc9b175ba29c8279d1962d.content: The Light Agent Primitive enables users to create Light Agents, which are sub-agents operating on top of the Agent's Executor Accord, conferring the advantages of Sky GovOps at a lower cost, but without direct access to other Sky Primitives.

237129ca:e37bacf7bd554b4e086b55b383fcad8.title: Sky Core-Designated Address

237129ca:871971ac1251701c30285908d3ee446.content: The Agent Creation Primitive is the first Sky Primitive that must be activated by prospective Agent founders. 237129ca:39c9990b0dd90f227824c82b0ae87c9.title: Agent Artifact Document Specification
237129ca:39c9990b0dd90f227824c82b0ae87c9.content: In the Sky Primitives Data Schema, references to an Agent Artifact Document are made in terms of the generic Document type. See A.1.2 - Atlas Documents - Structure, Categories, And Types Of Atlas Documents - List Of Document Types And Their Specifications. In practice, each Agent has its own Instance of that Document type in its Artifact. Thus, when a Primitive's process flow indicates that an Agent Artifact Document must be updated, it is to be interpreted as referring to the specific Instance of that Document type in the Star Agent's Artifact.

237129ca:f0ed83bd56bfb4f3980f23138322543.title: Proto-Agent Creation
237129ca:f0ed83bd56bfb4f3980f23138322543.content: Core GovOps creates a Proto-Agent with no specific functionality in the ecosystem.

237129ca:436b56c9d42de16881ee31a4772e757.title: Valuation
237129ca:436b56c9d42de16881ee31a4772e757.content: The market capitalization is determined as the total token supply multiplied by the TWAP of the token over the 24-hour period ending at 23:59 UTC on the last day of each month, immediately preceding the payment event. This value is applied in the rebate calculation under the Upkeep Rebate Primitive. See A.2.4 - Upkeep Rebate Primitive.

237129ca:910a716709d5e648e120cf883063364.title: Upkeep Rebate Primitive
237129ca:910a716709d5e648e120cf883063364.content:
The Upkeep Rebate Primitive allows a Star Agent (”Holding Agent”) to claim a rebate on its Ecosystem Upkeep Fees when it holds any portion of the token supply of another Star Agent (”Issuing Agent”).

Ecosystem Upkeep Fees are accounted on a monthly basis. The Upkeep Rebate is calculated on the same cadence per Holding Agent as follows:

1.  The Holding Agent’s share of the Issuing Agent’s token supply at the time the Issuing Agent pays its Ecosystem Upkeep Fees, multiplied by
2.  The total monthly Ecosystem Upkeep Fees paid by the Issuing Agent. For a Star Agent deploying the Distribution Requirement Primitive, the value of its total monthly Ecosystem Upkeep Fee is calculated pursuant to A.2.4 - Calculation of Distributed Tokens. For a Star Agent deploying the Market Cap Fee Primitive, the value of its total monthly Ecosystem Upkeep Fee is calculated pursuant to A.2.4 - Valuation.

This resulting rebate amount is applied against the Holding Agent’s Ecosystem Upkeep Fees due in the calendar month immediately following the Issuing Agent’s payment.

237129ca:aefc48a4d039495bfc7fbccbb84f57d.title: SkyLink Primitives
237129ca:aefc48a4d039495bfc7fbccbb84f57d.content: SkyLink Primitives are Sky Primitives that are technical infrastructure that extends the Sky Protocol. SkyLink Primitives are built autonomously by Star Agents, but owned by Sky Core and shared among all Star Agents. Star Agents are reimbursed for the cost of setting up SkyLink Primitives and given additional first-mover incentives.

237129ca:807612617fbb4f47272b70e6466b187.title: Stage 2 Virtual Base Rate
237129ca:807612617fbb4f47272b70e6466b187.content: In Stage 2 of the implementation of the Monthly Settlement Cycle, the net amount due from each Star to Sky is calculated as specified in the Atlas without the use of the Simplified Profit And Loss Calculation. However, interest under the Base Rate does not accrue in real time onchain and is instead calculated offchain and paid through Executive Votes as part of the Monthly Settlement Cycle. This is known as the Virtual Base Rate as these calculations occur offchain.

237129ca:8188870696aecead2780ddef91e8a71.title: Stage 3 Onchain Base Rate
237129ca:8188870696aecead2780ddef91e8a71.content: In Stage 3 of the implementation of the Monthly Settlement Cycle, the net amount due from each Star to Sky is calculated as specified in the Atlas without the use of the Simplified Profit And Loss Calculation. In Stage 3, interest from the Base Rate accrues onchain to the Allocator Vault of each Star. Thus, in Stage 3 Executive Votes are only required to pay down accrued interest on Allocator Vaults, as necessary, and settle other amounts due to and from Stars.

704f0378:bfe75f5c53df253e8f1be6d342ac9db.title: stUSDS Rate
704f0378:bfe75f5c53df253e8f1be6d342ac9db.content:
The variable yield earned by stUSDS holders is calculated using the formula:

```

            stUSDS Rate = Utilization * (SKY Borrow Rate - stUSDS Accessibility Reward) + (1 - Utilization) * Sky Savings Rate
```

Depositors earn a rate derived from the SKY Borrow Rate less the stUSDS Accessibility Reward on the utilized portion of their capital and the Sky Savings Rate on the unutilized portion.

704f0378:54100bad725bcd872f08eee20040a66.title: stUSDS Function
704f0378:54100bad725bcd872f08eee20040a66.content: stUSDS is a yield-bearing token representing USDS deposited into the stUSDS contract. Its primary function is to provide segregated risk capital for the SKY-backed borrowing mechanism. Users convert USDS to stUSDS to provide this capital and earn the stUSDS Rate. See A.4.4 - SKY Staking Mechanism - SKY Staking - SKY-Backed Borrowing - stUSDS Rate. stUSDS can be converted back to USDS subject to available unutilized liquidity in the stUSDS converter contract.

704f0378:938e1035312d7d7113ce41c26fa9c41.title: SKY-Backed Borrowing
704f0378:938e1035312d7d7113ce41c26fa9c41.content: SKY stakers can borrow USDS against their staked SKY collateral. This borrowing will be facilitated exclusively by the stUSDS system which will provide protocol-independent, or segregated, risk capital. The stUSDS system is currently in development; its elements are outlined in the subdocuments below. During the transition period to the stUSDS system, the protocol-dependent SKY-backed borrowing system remains operational and is governed by A.4.4 - SKY Staking Mechanism - SKY Staking - Short Term Transitionary Measures.

704f0378:baca4f85ec292adc80d6de38e1d8384.title: Agent Token Distribution Voting Rewards
704f0378:baca4f85ec292adc80d6de38e1d8384.content: SKY stakers are eligible to receive Agent Token rewards as specified in A.4.5. At the Monthly Settlement Cycle, Agent Tokens are distributed pro‑rata, by staked SKY, among wallets that have opted to receive a specific Agent Token for the cycle. To qualify for Agent Token payout a wallet must satisfy the Standard Activity criteria specified in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 4: Smart Burn And Standard Activity Staking Rewards - Standard Activity Staking Rewards - Payout From Standard Activity Staking Rewards Buffer.

616a4b50:816d8d36795e5de0b46bf8c6a35a9c7.title: Whistleblower Evidence Of Operational Security Breach Must Be Secured Ethically
616a4b50:816d8d36795e5de0b46bf8c6a35a9c7.content:
The phrase "responsibly provided" places limits on the sort of data, evidence and information that will enable a whistleblower to qualify for the bounty. Such data, evidence or information must have been secured ethically. A whistleblower who used publicly available blockchain data to demonstrate that an Aligned Delegate breached operational security best practices will qualify for the bounty. A whistleblower who hacked into the Aligned Delegate's devices or accounts to make this same demonstration will be disqualified from receiving the bounty.

Where reasonable people would disagree about the ethical nature of the whistleblower's actions, the Governance Facilitators should err on the side of disqualifying the whistleblower. In such instances, disqualification prevents the setting of precedent that might incentivize future whistleblowers to engage in unethical or illegal activities.

Both the Action Tenet and the above-stated presumption are supported by the Universal Alignment Assumption, which states that the "underlying intent of rules always aims to serve human values and promote public benefit within a given context." See A.0.1 - Atlas Preamble - Definitions - Universal Alignment Assumption.

616a4b50:518f9ac3d8bacf35c12d8aaf51cc23b.title: Whistleblower Evidence Must Have Material Impact
616a4b50:518f9ac3d8bacf35c12d8aaf51cc23b.content:
The element "useful" means that the evidence provided by the whistleblower must have had a material impact on the adjudication. The term "material impact" here does not imply that the adjudication process would have been impossible to resolve without the whistleblower's evidence. Instead, the evidence provided by the whistleblower can still be considered "useful" or of "material impact" if it serves a supportive role in the adjudication, even if it does not play a central or decisive part. The evidence simply needs to contribute meaningfully to the investigation, regardless of the extent of its influence. The Governance Facilitators ultimately have broad discretion here in awarding the bounty.

It is important to note that the payment of the whistleblower bounty is dependent on the outcome of the decision. If the Facilitators rule in favor of the AD, the bounty should not be awarded. If the Facilitators rule against the AD, the bounty should be awarded if the whistleblower has responsibly submitted useful evidence.

237129ca:0e4a88a931b2e87d63e15fd809b6293.content: The element "inaction" refers to the failure to act when action is necessary to prevent or address breaches of Universal Alignment or the Spirit of the Atlas. Inaction is considered as serious as active misalignment.

237129ca:286a88a1dcda4626d743440fa02eeab.title: Element Annotation
237129ca:286a88a1dcda4626d743440fa02eeab.content: The element "governance dynamic" refers generally to the balance of power and the integrity of operational processes that sustain Sky's Governance system. Disruption of this dynamic can lead to instability or misalignment.

237129ca:7cf2dd444ca23878c37355d2db7a98d.title: Element Annotation
237129ca:7cf2dd444ca23878c37355d2db7a98d.content: "Isolated Borrow" specifies whether an asset can be borrowed when a user is in Isolation Mode on the SparkLend platform.

237129ca:728b0c36ab251a6194fbbc42d57f7ee.title: Element Annotation
237129ca:728b0c36ab251a6194fbbc42d57f7ee.content: The element "governance attack" is a critical violation of the Sky ecosystem's governance protocols, far surpassing minor breaches in scope and impact. This term is reserved for misaligned acts with the near-term potential to severely compromise the Ecosystem's foundational structure and operational integrity. In contrast to mild breaches, which may involve actors with unintentional or benign motivations, a Governance Attack is distinguished by its deliberate and premeditated nature. Actors orchestrating such attacks are likely driven by strategic intent, aiming to destabilize or exploit the governance framework for their own gain.

237129ca:f6dd6cf7d6429097c837979a799fca5.content: The element "methodologies" refers to the systematic approaches or frameworks used to achieve the specific objective of optimizing and aligning the Core Stability Parameters.

761f38be:d94aca2a30aabb2e37f9a0ff7ebc005.title: Actively Stabilizing Collateral Rental Primitive
761f38be:d94aca2a30aabb2e37f9a0ff7ebc005.content: The Actively Stabilizing Collateral Rental Primitive is a mechanism enabling Star Agents to trade Asset Liability Management obligations between each other, providing more flexibility in how capital is deployed through the Allocation System and reducing duplicate work.

761f38be:aee491405deaf74e281453026c28da8.title: Junior Risk Capital Rental Primitive
761f38be:aee491405deaf74e281453026c28da8.content: The Junior Risk Capital Rental Primitive is a mechanism enabling Star Agents to rapidly rent Junior Risk Capital from each other, ensuring that capital gets deployed to where the best opportunities are.

761f38be:21c99922cef397e46fe81e3174df827.title: Core Governance Primitives
761f38be:21c99922cef397e46fe81e3174df827.content: Core Governance Primitives allow Star Agents to earn incentives for maintaining and securing Sky Governance frontends as well as borrow from the Smart Burn Engine.

761f38be:19eb2c9472641b5c2bab0b11b2830e7.title: Required Allocation Instance Fallback Strategy
761f38be:19eb2c9472641b5c2bab0b11b2830e7.content: The fallback strategy for each Allocation Instance must specify how Operational GovOps should determine when an emergency situation is occurring regarding the Allocation Instance and what actions it should take to protect the Star Agent from losses associated with the Allocation Instance. The fallback strategy must include emergency measures for Operational GovOps to reduce exposure to, drain, and ultimately shut down the Allocation Instance if Required Risk Capital or Asset Liability Management obligations are breached.

761f38be:adf942a36d8b7d1428ea504a8129690.title: Core Governance Reward Primitive
761f38be:adf942a36d8b7d1428ea504a8129690.content: The Core Governance Reward Primitive is a reward that Sky pays to Star Agents that provide SKY holders with secure access to the core Sky Governance features, ensuring that the Governance Security of Sky is maintained over time.

761f38be:fec23c9ba7cf56fd1d27f52861f5788.title: Required Allocation Conduit Asset Liability Management Strategy
761f38be:fec23c9ba7cf56fd1d27f52861f5788.content: The asset liability management strategy for each Allocation Instance must specify what steps Operational GovOps should take to ensure that the Star Agent continues to satisfy its Asset Liability Management obligations as the amount of funds allocated to the Conduit changes.

761f38be:c4107a4fb7816296485aaeddf7d7494.title: Treasury Management
761f38be:c4107a4fb7816296485aaeddf7d7494.content: The documents herein define the Sky Treasury Management Function.

761f38be:6422e9abc656060f138208a2d3dbb27.title: Required Allocation Instance Asset Liability Management Strategy
761f38be:6422e9abc656060f138208a2d3dbb27.content: The allocation strategy for each Allocation Instance should specify how Operational GovOps should adjust the amount of funds allocated to the Conduit based on performance, market conditions, or other factors. It should also specify limits to the amount by which the allocation can be adjusted before a vote of Star Agent token holders is required.

761f38be:296afb30a79b4a55fd2aec669b40a6f.title: Actively Stabilizing Collateral Rental
761f38be:296afb30a79b4a55fd2aec669b40a6f.content: To allow the Asset Liability Management obligation of Star Agents to be satisfied in the most efficient way possible, Star Agents may enter into Actively Stabilizing Collateral Rentals between each other, as specified in the Actively Stabilizing Collateral Rental Primitive. This allows one Star Agent to hold a greater amount of Actively Stabilizing Collateral to offset another Star Agent holding a lesser amount. Thus, the overall level of Actively Stabilizing Collateral is unaffected but the Actively Stabilizing Collateral can be held by a Star Agent that is able to more efficiently hold it.

761f38be:bb8238803ac8ac526fe7812375cf39c.title: Peg Defense Event
761f38be:bb8238803ac8ac526fe7812375cf39c.content: In addition to the requirement for Star Agents to hold a certain percentage of their Collateral Portfolio in Actively Stabilizing Collateral and the Demand Absorption Buffer, Star Agents have special responsibilities in extraordinary situations where the stability of the peg is threatened. The definition of these events and the obligations for Star Agents are specified in the implementation of the framework. See A.3.4 - A2 - Implementation.

761f38be:c6e1885002998e8321dde4f7d90c7f4.title: All Asset Liability Management Obligations Are Rented Together
761f38be:c6e1885002998e8321dde4f7d90c7f4.content: When Asset Liability Management obligations are rented, the associated obligations with regard to Actively Stabilizing Collateral, Demand Absorption Buffer, and Peg Defense Events are all transferred together.

761f38be:21f88b17d108444660ee8acb0683ba8.title: Application To Sky Core
761f38be:21f88b17d108444660ee8acb0683ba8.content: While its legacy ALM infrastructure is being transferred to Star Agents, Sky Core manages the portion of the Sky Collateral Portfolio not deployed by Star Agents ("Sky Core Collateral Portfolio"). During this transitional period, Sky Core must maintain, with respect to the Sky Core Collateral Portfolio, the same percentage of Actively Stabilizing Collateral and Demand Absorption Buffer required of Star Agents. The required percentages are specified in A.3.4 - Minimum Actively Stabilizing Collateral. This requirement remains in effect only until all legacy ALM infrastructure has been fully transitioned to Star Agents.

761f38be:25e1b1eefbaf5ba9438364ce3c814d2.title: Implementation
761f38be:25e1b1eefbaf5ba9438364ce3c814d2.content: This Section defines the current implementation of the Asset Liability Management framework.

761f38be:e1314cf034ced2dd8906ffdacc0dd04.title: Demand Absorption Buffer
761f38be:e1314cf034ced2dd8906ffdacc0dd04.content: The Demand Absorption Buffer is USDS that actively supports the peg of USDS by market-making and providing sell support at a price close to 1 USD per USDS. The implementation of the Asset Liability Management framework specifies the upside spread that is allowed for USDS to qualify toward the Demand Absorption Buffer. See A.3.4 - A2 - Implementation.

761f38be:bd79852580443f4cc80f4dcfff5137c.title: Definitions
761f38be:bd79852580443f4cc80f4dcfff5137c.content: The documents herein define terms used through the implementation of the Asset Liability Management framework.

524ce9a9:f3e57730781c78a661dda77e11500bf.title: Asset Liability Management Rental
524ce9a9:f3e57730781c78a661dda77e11500bf.content: To allow the Asset Liability Management obligation of Star Agents to be satisfied in the most efficient way possible, Star Agents may enter into Asset Liability Management Rentals between each other, as specified in the Asset Liability Management Rental Primitive. This allows one Star Agent to hold a greater amount of Actively Stabilizing Collateral to offset another Star Agent holding a lesser amount. Thus, the overall level of Actively Stabilizing Collateral is unaffected but the Actively Stabilizing Collateral can be held by a Star Agent that is able to more efficiently hold it.

524ce9a9:bb8238803ac8ac526fe7812375cf39c.title: Peg Defense Event
524ce9a9:bb8238803ac8ac526fe7812375cf39c.content: In addition to the requirement for Star Agents to hold a certain percentage of their Collateral Portfolio in Actively Stabilizing Collateral and the Demand Absorption Buffer, Star Agents have special responsibilities in extraordinary situations where the stability of the peg is threatened. The definition of these events and the obligations for Star Agents are specified in the implementation of the framework. See A.3.4 - A2 - Implementation.
