baf25904:bd174379ea72873125bc88669e4375b.title: Determining Protego Parameters
baf25904:bd174379ea72873125bc88669e4375b.content: The parameters for the scheduled Spell to be canceled, as specified in A.1.9 - Sky Core Governance Security - Emergency Spells - Protego Parameters, should always be determined by inspecting the logs emitted from the plot function of the Pause contract. The parameters should never be determined by calling functions on the Spell to be canceled, because these functions may not return the correct values in the case of a malicious Spell.

baf25904:84594028c5d4a29569a520fe9ca9465.title: Custom Spell Voting For Protego Usage
baf25904:84594028c5d4a29569a520fe9ca9465.content: The Governance Facilitators may use the Custom Spell Voting Page when it is beneficial to coordinate voting without having a visible Spell on the Voting Portal. The Governance Facilitators must not use this method unless domain expert Ecosystem Actors in the Emergency Response Group have recommended this approach; such a recommendation must be explicitly documented in the communication channel specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Response Signal Group.

baf25904:c645642ad9894179679c1d0afa9f0b0.title: Governance Facilitators’ Role In Standby Spells
baf25904:c645642ad9894179679c1d0afa9f0b0.content: All Governance Facilitators must promptly acknowledge receipt of the Support Facilitators’ decision to use a Standby Spell. This acknowledgment must take place in the communication channel specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Response Signal Group. The Governance Facilitators are responsible for actioning the Standby Spell and liaising with the Prime Delegates (and other Aligned Delegates as needed) to gather the necessary support for it.

baf25904:318f2fd56eb3bc61bc59e9c79173790.title: Support Scope Facilitators’ Role In Standby Spells
baf25904:318f2fd56eb3bc61bc59e9c79173790.content: The role of the Support Facilitators in the Standby Spell process is as follows: • Standby Spells can only be used in response to a properly validated and categorized emergency scenario, for which the Support Facilitators are responsible. See A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Incident Validation and A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Incident Categorization. The decision to use a Standby Spell is reserved for the Support Facilitators; where possible, the Support Facilitators should consult with the responsible Facilitator of the impacted Scope(s) and any relevant Scope Advisor(s). See A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Facilitators’s Roles And Responsibilities. • The Support Facilitators must explicitly communicate the decision to use a Standby Spell in the secure, private communication channel specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Response Signal Group or on a “war room” video call. • If the decision to use a Standby Spell is first reached on a video call, the Support Facilitators are required thereafter to promptly document their decision in the secure, private communication channel specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Response Signal Group. • After the Support Facilitators decide to use a Standby Spell, TechOps must promptly trigger an incident to the Emergency Response Group as specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency-Contact Mechanism Trigger.

baf25904:0283d55e990aba51a031d81662009b4.title: Requirement To Validate Authenticity Of Standby Spell
baf25904:0283d55e990aba51a031d81662009b4.content:
One Authorized Representative, as defined in the subdocument below, from each Governance Facilitator must validate the authenticity of the Standby Spell.
This validation must be in the form of a written communication in the secure channel specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Response Signal Group. Only the entities specified in A.1.9 - Sky Core Governance Security - Emergency Spells - Current Entities Authorized To Validate Authenticity of Standby Spell are authorized to provide the validation of authenticity.

Pursuant to A.1.9 - Sky Core Governance Security - Emergency Spells - ADs’ Role In Standby Spells, ADs are prohibited from voting for a Standby Spell without this validation of authenticity.

baf25904:d1b40746825213dd6702a9d6a93a190.title: Standby Spell Process Definition
baf25904:d1b40746825213dd6702a9d6a93a190.content: The subdocuments herein define the process for using Standby Spells.

baf25904:f2a21b112d0194ace3b2f2e9429a2fd.title: Current Entities Authorized To Validate Authenticity of Standby Spell
baf25904:f2a21b112d0194ace3b2f2e9429a2fd.content:
This document defines the term “Authorized Representative” as used in A.1.9 - Sky Core Governance Security - Emergency Spells - Requirement To Validate Authenticity Of Standby Spell. The entities listed below are authorized to validate the authenticity of a Standby Spell on behalf of the specified Governance Facilitators:

-   JanSky on behalf of Governance Facilitator team JanSky
-   VoteWizard on behalf of Governance Facilitator team Endgame Edge
-   LDR on behalf of Governance Facilitator team JanSky
-   CivicSage on behalf of Governance Facilitator team Endgame Edge

The Authorized Representatives listed are synonymous with the Sky Forum account holders with the following handles:

-   JanSky
-   votewizard
-   ldr
-   CivicSage

baf25904:bd7f901acd2f86372efe71d7029c997.title: SPBEAMHaltSpell
baf25904:bd7f901acd2f86372efe71d7029c997.content: This Standby Spell can be used in an emergency to disable the Stability Parameter Bounded External Access Module (SP-BEAM). See A.3.9 - Measures For Endgame Transition - Stability Parameter Bounded External Access Module. After this Standby Spell is invoked, the SP-BEAM will no longer be able to set rates in the system. Invoking the Standby Spell has no impact on rates, which remain at pre-invocation levels until adjusted by Sky Governance via an Executive Vote.

baf25904:40b7cf0c9f2fa52568f583717d39a29.title: Custom Spell Voting For Standby Spells
baf25904:40b7cf0c9f2fa52568f583717d39a29.content: The Governance Facilitators may use the Custom Spell Voting Page when it is beneficial to coordinate voting without having a visible spell on the Voting Portal. The Governance Facilitators must not use this method unless domain expert Ecosystem Actors in the Emergency Response Group have recommended this approach; such recommendation must be explicitly documented in the communication channel specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Response Signal Group.

baf25904:5964c17c2c292b9d7c0652db718c468.title: Emergency-Contact Mechanism Trigger
baf25904:5964c17c2c292b9d7c0652db718c468.content: Upon receiving notification from the Support Facilitators of a validated and categorized emergency situation, TechOps must trigger a notification in the Emergency Contact Mechanism specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Contact Mechanism. All Emergency Response Group Members are required to acknowledge the incident in a timely manner through the Emergency Contact Mechanism. The notification must include a link to the official Emergency Response video call (”war room”).

baf25904:d6ee578499b248fe343274fb73fd650.title: Incident Categorization
baf25904:d6ee578499b248fe343274fb73fd650.content: The Support Facilitators are responsible for categorizing emergencies according to their severity and other pertinent criteria.

baf25904:edf00a6192c302cc06a33e8e8be95d7.title: Emergency Response Video Call Coordination
baf25904:edf00a6192c302cc06a33e8e8be95d7.content: Emergency Response Group Members are required to promptly join the Video Call to coordinate incident response.

baf25904:87e35e09108b205e68afbeabd3ca991.title: Incident Validation
baf25904:87e35e09108b205e68afbeabd3ca991.content: The Support Facilitators are responsible for determining whether a reported incident is a valid emergency; where possible, this can be done in consultation with the responsible Facilitator of the impacted Scope(s) and any relevant Scope Advisor(s).

baf25904:f9647b5818e25dde9adb145f39765d2.title: Known And Uncontentious Remedies
baf25904:f9647b5818e25dde9adb145f39765d2.content: If a remedy is known and uncontentious, the Support and Governance Facilitators shall coordinate with the necessary Ecosystem Actors to expedite an Executive Vote. Emergency procedures involving an Executive Vote are defined in A.1.9 - A4 - Sky Core Governance Security - Emergency Spells.

baf25904:33ad9ddd89ea345404a73df855ba520.title: Emergency Response Process Definition
baf25904:33ad9ddd89ea345404a73df855ba520.content: The subdocuments herein define the emergency response process.

baf25904:c12ed5193efc8579ff9315efd98ed5d.title: Emergency Declaration Procedure
baf25904:c12ed5193efc8579ff9315efd98ed5d.content:
The Support Facilitators are empowered to declare an emergency situation at their discretion, either on their own initiative or in response to a request from a community member.
When declaring an emergency, the Support Facilitators should create a formal post on the Sky Forum which provides sufficient detail regarding the issue and explains why immediate action is required. If the situation allows, Facilitators should post the emergency declaration on the Sky Forum before taking action. If the urgency of the situation requires immediate intervention without delay, the Facilitators should create the Forum post as soon as possible after, or simultaneously with, the emergency action.
There may be situations in which a public Emergency Declaration would be counterproductive to security objectives; the Support Facilitators are granted discretion in these matters.
Creating a signal request thread or Governance Poll is optional.

baf25904:4b6b1a2c92e6bf1e55fa418723aff69.title: ADs’ Role In Standby Spells
baf25904:4b6b1a2c92e6bf1e55fa418723aff69.content: ADs are strictly prohibited from acting on a Standby Spell unless they have first confirmed all of the following requirements: • Receipt of the Support Facilitator’s official notification of the emergency scenario in the Emergency Contact Mechanism specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency-Contact Mechanism Trigger. • Receipt of the Support Facilitators’ announcement of a Standby Spell in the communication channel specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Response Signal Group; and • All Governance Facilitators have validated the authenticity of the Standby Spell. This validation must fulfill two requirements: (1) the validation must be in the form of a written communication in the secure channel specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Response Signal Group; and (2) the validation must be provided by the authorized entities listed in A.1.9 - Sky Core Governance Security - Emergency Spells - Current Entities Authorized To Validate Authenticity of Standby Spell. After ADs have confirmed all requirements are met, they must either promptly vote to approve the Standby Spell, or communicate any concerns to the Governance Facilitators and collaborate with the latter for a speedy resolution.

baf25904:9a3b3abd604255424e882b3f867d263.title: AD Reliance On Governance Facilitators In Standby Spell Process Where Governance Facilitator Is Nonresponsive
baf25904:9a3b3abd604255424e882b3f867d263.content: There is an exception to the requirement that all Governance Facilitators must validate the authenticity of a Standby Spell. In situations where a Governance Facilitator has failed to respond to the emergency situation, the Support Facilitators may temporarily grant the responding Governance Facilitator(s) the sole authority to validate the authenticity of the Emergency Spell pursuant to A.1.9 - Sky Core Governance Security - Emergency Spells - ADs’ Role In Standby Spells. The Support Facilitators must communicate this in writing in the secure channel specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Response Signal Group.

baf25904:4bb4948f732dee35c39c50af6ed9ea2.title: Misalignment To Vote For Unvalidated Standby Spell
baf25904:4bb4948f732dee35c39c50af6ed9ea2.content: It is severe misalignment for an Aligned Delegate to vote for a Standby Spell whose authenticity has not been validated pursuant to A.1.9 - Sky Core Governance Security - Emergency Spells - ADs’ Role In Standby Spells. Aligned Delegates in breach of this requirement must be immediately derecognized and their full AD Buffer should be confiscated.

baf25904:6958e879d1d58a88fd47bfc30ce0fda.title: ADs’ Role In Protego Usage
baf25904:6958e879d1d58a88fd47bfc30ce0fda.content:
ADs are strictly prohibited from voting to use an Emergency Drop Spell, or to give authority to the Protego contract, unless they have first confirmed all of the following requirements:

1.  Receipt of the Support Facilitator’s official notification of the emergency scenario in the Emergency Contact Mechanism specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency-Contact Mechanism Trigger;
2.  Receipt of the Support Facilitators’ announcement of the decision to use Protego or an Emergency Drop Spell in the communication channel specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Response Signal Group; and
3.  All Governance Facilitators have validated the authenticity of the Emergency Drop Spell, if applicable. This validation must fulfill two requirements: (1) the validation must be in the form of a written communication in the secure channel specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Response Signal Group; and (2) the validation must be provided by the authorized entities listed in A.1.9 - Sky Core Governance Security - Emergency Spells - Current Entities Authorized To Validate Authenticity of Emergency Drop Spell.

After ADs have confirmed all requirements are met, they must either (1) promptly vote to approve the usage of Protego or the Emergency Drop Spell, or (2) communicate any concerns to the Governance Facilitators and collaborate with the latter for a speedy resolution.

baf25904:a2a4091c57ecd478c07a02fd65b32c3.title: AD Reliance On Governance Facilitators In Emergency Drop Spell Process Where Governance Facilitator Is Nonresponsive
baf25904:a2a4091c57ecd478c07a02fd65b32c3.content: There is an exception to the requirement that all Governance Facilitators must validate the authenticity of an Emergency Drop Spell. In situations where a Governance Facilitator has failed to respond to the emergency situation, the Support Facilitators may temporarily grant the responding Governance Facilitator(s) the sole authority to validate the authenticity of the Emergency Drop Spell pursuant to A.1.9 - Sky Core Governance Security - Emergency Spells - ADs’ Role In Protego Usage. The Support Facilitators must communicate this in writing in the secure channel specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response - Emergency Response Signal Group.

baf25904:2bea4a430c8d4147829d7ca4b62c44c.title: Misalignment To Vote For Unvalidated Emergency Drop Spell
baf25904:2bea4a430c8d4147829d7ca4b62c44c.content: It is severe misalignment for an Aligned Delegate to vote for an Emergency Drop Spell whose authenticity has not been validated pursuant to A.1.9 - Sky Core Governance Security - Emergency Spells - ADs’ Role In Protego Usage. Aligned Delegates in breach of this requirement must be immediately derecognized and their full AD Buffer should be confiscated.

79abe87f:2fc2b00c0e096b2d5d15ae51631601d.title: Conservatorship For Breach Of Capital Requirements
79abe87f:2fc2b00c0e096b2d5d15ae51631601d.content: In the event that less extreme measures are not adequate to address the capital shortfall, Core GovOps may seek to put the Star Agent into conservatorship, in which case Sky Core Facilitators take direct control of the Star Agent to maximize value for Sky and other Star Agent stakeholders. Seeking to put a Star Agent into conservatorship requires immediate escalation to Sky Core Governance and requires an expedited Executive Vote as specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response Process - Known And Uncontentious Remedies.

79abe87f:bdec3c8108c7c0ab13752d63b3dd52f.title: Restrictions On Investments For Breach Of Capital Requirement
79abe87f:bdec3c8108c7c0ab13752d63b3dd52f.content: Core GovOps may impose whatever restrictions it deems necessary on the usage of the Allocation System Primitive by the Star Agent, including limiting the Star Agent's exposure to certain Instances (conduits) or prohibiting the Star Agent from using certain Instances. These restrictions may extend for a period of time that Core GovOps deems fit.

79abe87f:50cd2073baca51165d2040d0738d58b.title: Penalty Mechanisms For Operational Executor Agents
79abe87f:50cd2073baca51165d2040d0738d58b.content: The documents herein specify the penalty mechanisms for Operational Executor Agents for breaches of Risk Capital requirements.

79abe87f:93a9be22b705f3d72e663df896f9fcd.title: Additional Token Issuance For Breach Of Capital Requirements
79abe87f:93a9be22b705f3d72e663df896f9fcd.content: In the event that financial penalties are not sufficient to address the shortfall because payment of the penalties would exacerbate an existing capital shortfall, Core GovOps may require the Star Agent to issue additional tokens and sell them to the extent it deems necessary. Operational GovOps will assist Core GovOps in executing any such transaction. Future iterations of the Risk Capital framework will specify a more detailed methodology for required token issuance.

79abe87f:c9b3cd62a304046e159a6aa62d355ce.title: Financial Penalties For Operational Executor Agents
79abe87f:c9b3cd62a304046e159a6aa62d355ce.content: In the near term there are no penalties for Operational Executor Agents for failure of the Star Agents they supervise to maintain appropriate levels of capital. In future iterations of the Risk Framework, Operational Executor Agents will be required to put up collateral and act as "insurers" of all activities by the Star Agents they supervise with regard to the Sky Primitives. At that point Core GovOps will be able to seize this collateral in the event of failure to obtain compensation for breaches of the Risk Capital requirement by the Star Agent.

79abe87f:bae5fb80a26662339aab6cbac6cc71a.title: Short Term Exemption
79abe87f:bae5fb80a26662339aab6cbac6cc71a.content: While the risk framework undergoes refinement, penalties for any Star Agent breaches of Required Risk Capital will be calculated by Core GovOps once the infrastructure is in place to do so. This calculation serves the purposes of system monitoring, data gathering, and framework calibration. However, throughout this interim phase, such calculated penalties will not be formally assessed against Star Agents, and consequently, Star Agents will not be required to make payment for these penalties. Notwithstanding this temporary exemption from penalty payment, Star Agents are expected to maintain a Risk Tolerance Ratio of at least 90%. See A.3.3 - Risk Tolerance Ratio.

79abe87f:fa3fe35779ee659c0e4dbdede09ff0b.title: Termination Of Executor Accord
79abe87f:fa3fe35779ee659c0e4dbdede09ff0b.content: In the event that Core GovOps determines that the Operational Executor Agent is not appropriately supervising the activities of the Star Agent, Core GovOps may terminate the respective Executor Accord. This requires an immediate escalation to Sky Governance and requires an expedited Executive Vote as specified in A.1.8 - Emergency Response System - Emergency Response Process - Known And Uncontentious Remedies. Core GovOps must arrange for another Operational Executor Agent to stand in until the Star Agent can Invoke the Executor Accord Primitive to enter into a new Executor Accord. The Star Agent must suspend all operations until a new Executor Accord is voted on and formally integrated into the Agent's Artifact.

79abe87f:7d7adf5de0d6869e4ff21c9e01f15cf.title: Escalation To Sky Governance
79abe87f:7d7adf5de0d6869e4ff21c9e01f15cf.content: The documents herein specify measures for escalating situations directly to Sky Governance in the event that they cannot be resolved by Core GovOps.

79abe87f:2c2e4da298472fef8aad1f067f70dc1.title: Triggers For Escalation
79abe87f:2c2e4da298472fef8aad1f067f70dc1.content: In the event of a disagreement regarding the penalties for a violation of Risk Capital requirements, either party may escalate the matter to Sky Governance. In addition, the extraordinary remedies of Star Agent Conservatorship and Executor Accord Termination must always be escalated to a Sky Governance Executive Vote.

79abe87f:fcc2ea2e0e0b4f2769a95eab917ff01.title: Sky Governance Process
79abe87f:fcc2ea2e0e0b4f2769a95eab917ff01.content: Once a matter has been escalated to Sky Governance, the Sky Core Facilitators may request any information they deem necessary from Core GovOps, Operational GovOps, and the Star Agent. Sky Governance then acts through a Governance Poll to determine its resolution of the matter.

baf25904:650b650bc3c6afad54d14ea8005f656.title: Agents Credit Line Borrow Rate
baf25904:650b650bc3c6afad54d14ea8005f656.content: The Agents Credit Line Borrow Rate is the annual percentage rate that Agents must pay to Sky Core to receive USDS liquidity into their respective vaults.

baf25904:f20b24890839e40d86cd8c2f75f55bb.title: Sky Savings Rate Stability Parameter Bounded External Access Module Parameters
baf25904:f20b24890839e40d86cd8c2f75f55bb.content: The Stability Parameter Bounded External Access Module parameters for the Sky Savings Rate are: • max - 3,000 basis points, • min - 200 basis points, • step - 400 basis points, • tau - Globally defined in A.3.9 - Measures For Endgame Transition - Stability Parameter Bounded External Access Module - Definitions - Tau Definition - Tau Current Value.

baf25904:99c47a631b86128e2721f06ef36c9ac.title: Agents Credit Line Borrow Rate Risk Limits
baf25904:99c47a631b86128e2721f06ef36c9ac.content: USDS liquidity that Agents receive from Sky Core can be deployed across Conduits within risk limits defined by the Stability Facilitators.

baf25904:43be5c2b657dcb9a6c42b7170a81a53.title: Sky Savings Rate Modification
baf25904:43be5c2b657dcb9a6c42b7170a81a53.content: The Sky Savings Rate can be modified through either Executive Votes or the Stability Parameter Bounded External Access Module. See A.3.9 - Measures For Endgame Transition - Stability Parameter Bounded External Access Module.

baf25904:086d641e0be7052062b1fe142f09618.title: Conceptual Framework
baf25904:086d641e0be7052062b1fe142f09618.content: This Section defines the conceptual framework for Risk Capital.

baf25904:3aef6d2f5e03d54a9c8f09e48a3b01f.title: Sky Savings Rate
baf25904:3aef6d2f5e03d54a9c8f09e48a3b01f.content: The Sky Savings Rate ("SSR") is the rate USDS holders can earn on their USDS in the Sky Savings Rate smart contracts.

baf25904:ea99a8be99b79c82170d100e00ba751.title: Required Risk Capital
baf25904:ea99a8be99b79c82170d100e00ba751.content: The documents herein define the conceptual framework for determining the amount of Risk Capital that Star Agents are required to hold to protect Sky from risks on their investments.

79abe87f:f86bfcf8c95d278454572e83263ab8e.title: Agent Credit Line Borrow Rate
79abe87f:f86bfcf8c95d278454572e83263ab8e.content: The Agent Credit Line Borrow Rate is the annual percentage rate that Agents must pay to Sky Core to receive USDS liquidity into their respective vaults.

79abe87f:16feff883e76f5faa296be58d44bec6.title: Dai Savings Rate Stability Parameter Bounded External Access Module Parameters
79abe87f:16feff883e76f5faa296be58d44bec6.content:
The Stability Parameter Bounded External Access Module parameters for the Dai Savings Rate are:

-   max - 3,000 basis points
-   min - 0 basis points
-   step - 400 basis points
-   tau - Globally defined in A.3.9 - Measures For Endgame Transition - Stability Parameter Bounded External Access Module - Definitions - Tau Definition - Tau Current Value.

79abe87f:866bd5f687a2fde9d463977a8be53a5.title: Relationship To Base Rate
79abe87f:866bd5f687a2fde9d463977a8be53a5.content: The Agent Credit Line Borrow Rate is equal to the Base Rate.

79abe87f:c677d609a2de3bce37a25eb8a239e58.title: Dai Savings Rate Modification
79abe87f:c677d609a2de3bce37a25eb8a239e58.content: The Dai Savings Rate can be modified through either Executive Votes or the Stability Parameter Bounded External Access Module. See A.3.9 - Measures For Endgame Transition - Stability Parameter Bounded External Access Module. The Dai Savings Rate must gradually be reduced to 0% over time.

79abe87f:17f578d0e58b88f96412c44e1306ada.title: Subsidized Rate
79abe87f:17f578d0e58b88f96412c44e1306ada.content: Star Agents may temporarily be able to borrow specified amounts from Sky Core at a Subsidized Rate below the Base Rate under the terms of an Ecosystem Accord entered into between Sky and the Star Agent.

79abe87f:87385d26b52e559801d34a5c6f91411.title: Dai Savings Rate
79abe87f:87385d26b52e559801d34a5c6f91411.content: The Dai Savings Rate ("DSR") is the rate Dai holders can earn on their Dai in the Dai Savings Rate smart contracts.

79abe87f:62ed8a0cc34bf264f7e4d189409b583.title: Accrued Interest
79abe87f:62ed8a0cc34bf264f7e4d189409b583.content: Funds must be regularly transferred from the SubProxy account of each Star Agent borrowing from Sky Core to the Allocation Vault for the Star Agent so that the Allocation Vault only reflects the principal balance as of the date of transfer. Any accrued interest that has not yet been transferred from the SubProxy account must be deducted from the Star Agent's Total Risk Capital. See A.3.3 - Total Risk Capital Definition.

baf25904:371cfcf9024265c38afe1d2e8e02bd3.title: Allocation Conduit Setup Real World Agreements And Planning
baf25904:371cfcf9024265c38afe1d2e8e02bd3.content: The documents herein define the preliminary, off-chain human coordination stage of setting up an Allocation Conduit.

baf25904:4457c33f71ce84784312db0a4ca5f98.title: Allocation Conduit Setup Process Definition
baf25904:4457c33f71ce84784312db0a4ca5f98.content: The documents herein define the process for setting up an Allocation Conduit as part of the Allocation System Primitive.

baf25904:c145213d5bdd7612748d7acfebd3e0f.title: Allocation Conduit Setup Initial Concept And Feasibility Discussions
baf25904:c145213d5bdd7612748d7acfebd3e0f.content: The Star Agent identifies a yield opportunity on a target chain that can exceed the Base Rate. The Star Agent estimates First Loss Capital and Asset Liability Management requirements associated with the the opportunity and evaluates options for fulfilling them. The Star Agent also considers exchange and bridging costs, if applicable. Based on this, the Star Agent develops a net yield target for the opportunity factoring in all of these costs. The output of this step is an internal meeting note summarizing the idea as well as estimates of First Loss Capital, Asset Liability Management, and exchange / bridging costs.

baf25904:4ed1bc3838db4d98a5659812db42cc2.title: Allocation System Process Definition
baf25904:4ed1bc3838db4d98a5659812db42cc2.content: The documents herein define the process for initial setup and ongoing management of an Allocation Conduit as part of the Allocation System Primitive.

baf25904:e015f06c9b0c7c314690259b2cbdf8a.title: Allocation Conduit Setup Preliminary First Loss Capital and Asset Liability Management Arrangement
baf25904:e015f06c9b0c7c314690259b2cbdf8a.content: If necessary, the Star Agent reaches out to other Star Agents that could provide First Loss Capital or assume Asset Liability Management obligations. The Star Agent negotiates with these other Star Agents and documents these potential deals. The output of this step is an informal confirmation of First Loss Capital and Asset Liability Management transfer details and draft references for the upcoming Star Agent Artifact update.

baf25904:f8003500506e9d88ab9c044792441ba.title: Allocation System Primitive
baf25904:f8003500506e9d88ab9c044792441ba.content: The Allocation System Primitive is the base mechanism that enables Star Agents to put up First Loss Capital to deploy USDS collateral into different opportunities that provide risk-adjusted return, by borrowing at the Base Rate from Sky, and following Asset Liability Management restrictions on the liquidity of deployed assets.

baf25904:c9fcfeaaac9408ed24dfd465770ff43.title: Allocation Conduit Setup Preliminary Informal Check With Operational GovOps
baf25904:c9fcfeaaac9408ed24dfd465770ff43.content: The Star Agent presents the plan for the Allocation Conduit to Operational GovOps, including any associated First Loss Capital and Asset Liability Management arrangements. Operational GovOps reviews and either provides an informal greenlight or requests modifications. The output of this step is approval to proceed with revision requests, if needed.

baf25904:f012426ca77346eca0e974b3366b66d.title: Token SkyLink Setup Real World Agreements And Planning
baf25904:f012426ca77346eca0e974b3366b66d.content: The documents herein define the preliminary, off-chain human coordination stage of setting up an Instance of the Token SkyLink Primitive.

baf25904:4d2ca8bb54dd8bafe979595cd7c0b1a.title: Token SkyLink Setup Process Definition
baf25904:4d2ca8bb54dd8bafe979595cd7c0b1a.content: The documents herein define the process for setting up an Instance of the Token SkyLink Primitive.

baf25904:285bd50dee892c6b3cec1f4136419ac.title: Token SkyLink Setup Target Chain Identification And Feasibility Analysis
baf25904:285bd50dee892c6b3cec1f4136419ac.content: The Star Agent researches potential target blockchains for token bridging, including evaluation of user base, DeFi ecosystem, and bridging security requirements. The Star Agent confirms that the target chain supports LayerZero or can be integrated easily with the LayerZero Omnichain Fungible Token standard. The Star Agent also estimates potential use of the token on the target chain to justify the bridge deployment and audit costs. The output of this step is a preliminary decision to proceed with deploying a bridge to the target chain including a scope of work for the bridge deployment and estimated audit costs.

baf25904:4fcc891ceae76864fedae1fda37fa3e.title: Token SkyLink Process Definition
baf25904:4fcc891ceae76864fedae1fda37fa3e.content: The documents herein define the Process Definition for initial setup and ongoing management of the Token SkyLink Primitive.

baf25904:92bba37efd9994dcfee0a3d0a5fa2cd.title: Token SkyLink Setup Initial Alignment With Operational GovOps
baf25904:92bba37efd9994dcfee0a3d0a5fa2cd.content: The Star Agent presents the bridging plan to Operational GovOps, including a technical summary, proposed timeline, and estimate of audit costs. The Star Agent and Operational GovOps also discuss any guidelines in the Atlas or the Agent Artifact that may affect bridging. The Star Agent receives early feedback on the plan and modifies it accordingly. The output of this step is an informal agreement to proceed with developing a bridge deployment along with any documented conditions or feedback from Operational GovOps.

baf25904:0603780962ecf51b7f73f7d9928c526.title: Token SkyLink Primitive
baf25904:0603780962ecf51b7f73f7d9928c526.content: The Token SkyLink Primitive allows users to bridge USDS, sUSDS, SKY, or an Agent token to new blockchains and enables other multichain features.

baf25904:14c2c906fd4ff0c13137dc978214f81.title: Token SkyLink Setup Audit Preparation And Proposal Of Costs
baf25904:14c2c906fd4ff0c13137dc978214f81.content: The Star Agent contacts a reputable third-party security audit firm for reviewing the bridge implementation. The Star Agent negotiates audit scope, timeline, and fees with the audit firm. The Star Agent documents the projected cost for the bridge, including development, audit, and deployment costs, for future reimbursement. The outcome of this step is a formal agreement with the audit firm and a detailed cost breakdown for bridge deployment and auditing.

79abe87f:de2a24fef804588a91239fd2f44c4ef.title: Real World Agreements And Planning
79abe87f:de2a24fef804588a91239fd2f44c4ef.content: The documents herein define the preliminary, off-chain human coordination stage of setting up an Allocation Instance.

79abe87f:0192d369788a1b78fd43c972fc73f83.title: Allocation Instance Setup Process Definition
79abe87f:0192d369788a1b78fd43c972fc73f83.content: The documents herein define the process for setting up an Allocation Instance as part of the Allocation System Primitive.

79abe87f:cd93e839303dc5e387a4b2fc0420642.title: Initial Concept And Feasibility Discussions
79abe87f:cd93e839303dc5e387a4b2fc0420642.content: The Star Agent identifies a yield opportunity on a target chain that can exceed the Base Rate. The Star Agent estimates Required Risk Capital (RRC) and Asset Liability Management requirements associated with the opportunity and evaluates options for fulfilling them. The Star Agent also considers exchange and bridging costs, if applicable. Based on this, the Star Agent develops a net yield target for the opportunity factoring in all of these costs. The output of this step is an internal meeting note summarizing the idea as well as estimates of Required Risk Capital, Asset Liability Management, and exchange / bridging costs.

79abe87f:b30f8fb04fb4e9eb0f91f08aa6fa6b9.title: Allocation System Process Definition
79abe87f:b30f8fb04fb4e9eb0f91f08aa6fa6b9.content: The documents herein define the process for initial setup and ongoing management of an Allocation Instance (alternatively referred to as "conduits") as part of the Allocation System Primitive.

79abe87f:975bb137e03640c5e8faaaa747bd422.title: Preliminary Required Risk Capital and Asset Liability Management Arrangement
79abe87f:975bb137e03640c5e8faaaa747bd422.content: If necessary, the Star Agent reaches out to other Star Agents that could provide Junior Risk Capital (JRC) / Senior Risk Capital (SRC) or assume Asset Liability Management obligations. The Star Agent negotiates with these other Star Agents and documents these potential deals. The output of this step is an informal confirmation of JRC/SRC and Asset Liability Management transfer details.

79abe87f:f78394b3afd7b14ed37c24723c0d252.title: Allocation System Primitive
79abe87f:f78394b3afd7b14ed37c24723c0d252.content: The Allocation System Primitive is the base mechanism that enables Star Agents to put up Risk Capital to deploy USDS collateral into different opportunities that provide risk-adjusted return, by borrowing at the Base Rate from Sky, and following Asset Liability Management restrictions on the liquidity of deployed assets.

79abe87f:e4c71719c866565dccd4bdb4a283202.title: Star Agent Preparation Of Capital And Operational Plan
79abe87f:e4c71719c866565dccd4bdb4a283202.content:
The Capital and Operational Plan ("C&O Plan") articulates the Star Agent's strategy for a proposed new Allocation Instance or a modification to an existing Instance. In addition to articulating the Instance's strategic objectives and operational parameters, the C&O Plan includes a pro-forma Required Risk Capital (RRC) estimate and a strategy for ensuring sufficient Total Risk Capital (TRC) coverage.

The C&O Plan is the major input into the Artifact Edit Proposal that codifies the new or modified Instance. Following the approval of such a proposal by Star governance, the details and commitments outlined in the C&O Plan are formally integrated into the respective Instance Configuration Document of the Star Agent's Artifact.

baf25904:0b3e3e923cf99eb62fc45bcb5b8f63b.title: Non-Real Time Updates
baf25904:0b3e3e923cf99eb62fc45bcb5b8f63b.content: In the near term, Star Agents may update calculations that are based on market or other external variables less frequently than real time. If they do so, Operational GovOps must apply a buffer to each variable that is not updated in real time to account for the fact that the variable may change in a way that increases the Risk Capital requirements between update frequencies.

baf25904:a38e9bb5c35e4a66c48ff3c57f0ded9.title: Near Real Time Updates By BA Labs
baf25904:a38e9bb5c35e4a66c48ff3c57f0ded9.content: In the near term, BA Labs will provide real time data regarding major lending markets. BA Labs will be compensated for this work as part of its existing relationship with Sky Core and Spark.

baf25904:f2af95a98f1d89744f81845c9c2ec23.content: Star Agents may develop data feeds that update the Atlas with their data at their expense. Alternatively, the Operational Executor Agent that has an Executor Accord with the Star Agent may perform this as part of the services it provides to the Star Agent. In this case, the Operational Executor Agent may charge whatever fees for this service the parties mutually agree on.

baf25904:f750363d8c3821c800206172f21ebeb.title: Responsibility For Data Updates
baf25904:f750363d8c3821c800206172f21ebeb.content: The Star Agent may assume responsibility for updating the inputs to the Risk Capital calculations itself, either directly or through one of its agents, or may contract with Operational GovOps to perform that function.

baf25904:192bcb0c085ac65e782c3de83dbe20f.title: Real Time Updates
baf25904:192bcb0c085ac65e782c3de83dbe20f.content: Inputs into Risk Capital calculations that are based on market or other external variables should be updated in real time or immediately after the underlying data is updated, if the underlying data is only updated periodically.

baf25904:b05a5efde1a00e8d2980feb680424dd.title: Verification Of Data Updates
baf25904:b05a5efde1a00e8d2980feb680424dd.content: If Operational GovOps does not perform the data updates, it must verify their accuracy.

baf25904:cbbd205b7350ab1599206e607554352.title: Deposit And Redemption Queues
baf25904:cbbd205b7350ab1599206e607554352.content:
The srUSDS contract utilizes distinct queues for managing conversions. Users can add USDS to the deposit queue for conversion into srUSDS; or add srUSDS to the redemption queue for conversion back into USDS at any point during the month.
Assets placed in either queue can be withdrawn by the user at any time before the Monthly Settlement Cycle begins.
At the Monthly Settlement Cycle, all assets remaining in the queues are processed: queued USDS is converted into srUSDS, and queued srUSDS is converted into USDS based on the prevailing Conversion Rate. See A.3.3 - Risk Capital - Implementation - Senior Risk Capital System Implementation - External Senior Risk Capital And srUSDS System - Conversion Rate.
ancestors: External Senior Risk Capital And srUSDS System

baf25904:319de2cd78e572bf3e6dd0f57260e92.title: srUSDS Contract
baf25904:319de2cd78e572bf3e6dd0f57260e92.content: srUSDS is the tokenized form of External Senior Risk Capital. Users can deposit USDS into the srUSDS contract to provide External Senior Risk Capital to the SRC system, making it available for origination by Star Agents. See A.3.3 - Risk Capital - Implementation - Senior Risk Capital System Implementation - Senior Risk Capital (SRC) Origination Process. srUSDS holders can potentially earn higher yields in exchange for the risk that the External Senior Risk Capital will suffer losses.
ancestors: External Senior Risk Capital And srUSDS System

baf25904:78f25bd5f912efa4fa8414aea037987.title: Conversion Rate
baf25904:78f25bd5f912efa4fa8414aea037987.content: The conversion rate represents the amount of USDS redeemable per unit of srUSDS. This rate increases or decreases over time, reflecting the net return earned by the ESRC pool. The rate is updated at the conclusion of each Monthly Settlement Cycle based on the performance of the ESRC pool during the preceding month, according to the following standard compounding formula: New srUSDS Conversion Rate = Previous Conversion Rate \* (1 + Monthly srUSDS Yield). The parameters of this formula are defined in the documents herein.
ancestors: External Senior Risk Capital And srUSDS System

baf25904:96b4bd4f53d8ca235b2bbca4fb3301b.title: External Senior Risk Capital And srUSDS System
baf25904:96b4bd4f53d8ca235b2bbca4fb3301b.content: The documents herein define rules and infrastructure pertaining to the sourcing of External Senior Risk Capital (ESRC). ESRC is capital provided by external investors to be invested as Senior Risk Capital of Star Agents.

baf25904:98126ccaa9d1e2a9d0322b8d4c44185.title: Previous Conversion Rate
baf25904:98126ccaa9d1e2a9d0322b8d4c44185.content: Previous Conversion Rate is the conversion rate (USDS per srUSDS) that was in effect at the beginning of the concluded monthly cycle. The initial conversion rate between srUSDS and USDS is 1:1.
ancestors: External Senior Risk Capital And srUSDS System

baf25904:dc30f42df7b6f95592ab54ef4c7e7b6.title: Sourcing Of Internal Senior Risk Capital
baf25904:dc30f42df7b6f95592ab54ef4c7e7b6.content: ISRC is sourced from the various surplus buffers, which are themselves funded via the Treasury Management Function. See A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps.

baf25904:509f77df391a2db366c0e7aa62bf60a.title: Monthly srUSDS Yield
baf25904:509f77df391a2db366c0e7aa62bf60a.content: Monthly srUSDS Yield represents the net percentage return earned solely by the ESRC pool during the concluded monthly cycle, distributable to srUSDS holders via the conversion rate adjustment. It directly reflects the risk-adjusted performance of the capital deployed and is calculated as: \[(Total Interest Paid by Stars on ESRC Portion - Losses Allocated to ESRC) / ESRC Principal at start of month - Sky Spread\] \* (1 - ESRC Earnings Fee). The Sky Spread and ESRC Earnings Fee are defined in A.3.3 - Risk Capital - Implementation - Senior Risk Capital System Implementation - External Senior Risk Capital And srUSDS System - Conversion Rate - Sources Of Revenue To Sky - Sky Spread and A.3.3 - Risk Capital - Implementation - Senior Risk Capital System Implementation - External Senior Risk Capital And srUSDS System - Conversion Rate - Sources Of Revenue To Sky - ESRC Earnings Fee, respectively.
ancestors: External Senior Risk Capital And srUSDS System

At the Monthly Settlement Cycle, all assets remaining in the queues are processed: queued USDS is converted into srUSDS, and queued srUSDS is converted into USDS based on the prevailing Conversion Rate. See A.3.3 - Conversion Rate.

79abe87f:4821bccc16c82033a2033e36032f58d.title: Conversion Rate
79abe87f:4821bccc16c82033a2033e36032f58d.content:
The conversion rate represents the amount of USDS redeemable per unit of srUSDS. This rate increases or decreases over time, reflecting the net return earned by the ESRC pool. The rate is updated at the conclusion of each Monthly Settlement Cycle based on the performance of the ESRC pool during the preceding month, according to the following standard compounding formula:

`New srUSDS Conversion Rate = Previous Conversion Rate * (1 + Monthly srUSDS Yield)`

The parameters of this formula are defined in the documents herein.

79abe87f:96b4bd4f53d8ca235b2bbca4fb3301b.title: External Senior Risk Capital And srUSDS System

79abe87f:ce332e92ac94f318ff3fed9845cd381.title: Previous Conversion Rate
79abe87f:ce332e92ac94f318ff3fed9845cd381.content: `Previous Conversion Rate` is the conversion rate (USDS per srUSDS) that was in effect at the beginning of the concluded monthly cycle. The initial conversion rate between srUSDS and USDS is 1:1.

79abe87f:d2558fc23ac4c47182628f609d1153f.title: Sourcing Of Internal Senior Risk Capital
79abe87f:d2558fc23ac4c47182628f609d1153f.content: ISRC is sourced from the various surplus buffers, which are themselves funded via the Treasury Management Function. See A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps.

79abe87f:6bac21d0925c037420a906be46e896b.title: Monthly srUSDS Yield
79abe87f:6bac21d0925c037420a906be46e896b.content:
`Monthly srUSDS Yield` represents the net percentage return earned solely by the ESRC pool during the concluded monthly cycle, distributable to srUSDS holders via the conversion rate adjustment. It directly reflects the risk-adjusted performance of the capital deployed and is calculated as:

`[(Total Interest Paid by Stars on ESRC Portion - Losses Allocated to ESRC) / ESRC Principal at start of month - Sky Spread] * (1 - ESRC Earnings Fee)`

The Sky Spread and ESRC Earnings Fee are defined in A.3.3 - Sky Spread and A.3.3 - ESRC Earnings Fee, respectively.

baf25904:1c50aa1c8f57c8b1905ea0578708891.title: Sources Of Revenue To Sky
baf25904:1c50aa1c8f57c8b1905ea0578708891.content: Sky earns revenue from facilitating ESRC from two sources. These sources are included in the formula and defined in the subdocuments below.
ancestors: External Senior Risk Capital And srUSDS System

baf25904:89e27ba29d4beebdd0e0893bb04a634.title: Sky Spread
baf25904:89e27ba29d4beebdd0e0893bb04a634.content: Sky takes a spread equal to the Sky Spread on all ESRC balances. The Sky Spread is the difference between (1) the rate at which Star Agents borrow from Sky and (2) the Sky Savings Rate plus the Accessibility Reward Fee.

baf25904:a84e517eb4954e533437f1d4d224d93.title: Required Allocation Conduit Allocation Strategy
baf25904:a84e517eb4954e533437f1d4d224d93.content: The allocation strategy for each Allocation Conduit should specify how Operational GovOps should adjust the amount of funds allocated to the Conduit based on performance, market conditions, or other factors. It should also specify limits to the amount by which the allocation can be adjusted before a vote of Star Agent token holders is required.

baf25904:e00bd73cb7368c1aeb4653578570599.title: Required Allocation Conduit Strategy
baf25904:e00bd73cb7368c1aeb4653578570599.content: For each Allocation Conduit, the Star Agent Artifact must specify the strategy documents contained herein. These strategy documents must describe in detail how the Allocation Conduit should be operated so that the Operational Executor Agent that the Star Agent has contracted with can operate the Allocation Conduit without further input from the Star Agent or having to make "judgment calls". To the extent that the Star Agent's strategy cuts across different Allocation Conduits, the Star Agent may include a single set of strategy documents covering all Allocation Conduits.

baf25904:9b9b15e8b6d8d7678683020476cadca.title: Required Allocation Conduit Asset Liability Management Strategy
baf25904:9b9b15e8b6d8d7678683020476cadca.content: The asset liability management strategy for each Allocation Conduit must specify what steps Operational GovOps should take to ensure that the Star Agent continues to satisfy its Asset Liability Management obligations as the amount of funds allocated to the Conduit changes.

baf25904:4d80cc70baf90a43c8e014b085807c1.title: Required Allocation Conduit Parameters
baf25904:4d80cc70baf90a43c8e014b085807c1.content: For each Allocation Conduit, the Star Agent Artifact must specify: (1) the name of the Allocation Conduit, (2) the address of the Allocation Conduit, (3) the rate limit of the conduit for inflows and outflows, (4) any other technical parameters of the Allocation Conduit (e.g. maximum slippage, oracles used), (5) data submission protocols, and (6) specification of emergency measures that can be used by Operational GovOps if First Loss Capital or Asset Liability Management obligations are breached.

baf25904:52f135729a2bb75fdf1ab49b151c75a.title: Required Allocation Conduit Fallback Strategy
baf25904:52f135729a2bb75fdf1ab49b151c75a.content: The fallback strategy for each Allocation Conduit must specify how Operational GovOps should determine when an emergency situation is occurring regarding the Allocation Conduit and what actions it should take to protect the Star Agent from losses associated with the Allocation Conduit. The fallback strategy must include emergency measures for Operational GovOps to reduce exposure to, drain, and ultimately shut down the Allocation Conduit if First Loss Capital or Asset Liability Management obligations are breached.

baf25904:38675aed116a120775b4b8cedf2ba94.title: List Of Allocation Conduits
baf25904:38675aed116a120775b4b8cedf2ba94.content: If the Allocation System Primitive is Activated, then the Star Agent Artifact must list each active Allocation Conduit, grouped by blockchain. For each blockchain, the Star Agent Artifact must specify: (1) the name of the blockchain, (2) the bridging mechanism for the blockchain, if any, (3) the allocation buffer on the blockchain, and (4) the Allocation Conduits on the blockchain. For each Allocation Conduit, the Star Agent Artifact must contain the information specified herein.

baf25904:4377fc63ff7bfe2235e363dfed06042.title: First Loss Capital Rental Primitive
baf25904:4377fc63ff7bfe2235e363dfed06042.content: The First Loss Capital Rental Primitive is a mechanism enabling Star Agents to rapidly rent First Loss Capital from each other, ensuring that capital gets deployed to where the best opportunities are.

baf25904:d94aca2a30aabb2e37f9a0ff7ebc005.title: Actively Stabilizing Collateral Rental Primitive
baf25904:d94aca2a30aabb2e37f9a0ff7ebc005.content: The Actively Stabilizing Collateral Rental Primitive is a mechanism enabling Star Agents to trade Asset Liability Management obligations between each other, providing more flexibility in how capital is deployed through the Allocation System and reducing duplicate work.

79abe87f:aee491405deaf74e281453026c28da8.content: The Junior Risk Capital Rental Primitive is a mechanism enabling Star Agents to rapidly rent Junior Risk Capital from each other, ensuring that capital gets deployed to where the best opportunities are.

baf25904:40eece1846a3fc5925148026b81da90.title: Senior Risk Capital System Implementation
baf25904:40eece1846a3fc5925148026b81da90.content: The documents herein define operational requirements and protocols for the implementation of the Senior Risk Capital system in the risk framework.

79abe87f:40eece1846a3fc5925148026b81da90.title: Senior Risk Capital System Implementation
79abe87f:40eece1846a3fc5925148026b81da90.content: The documents herein define operational requirements and protocols for the implementation of the Senior Risk Capital system in the risk framework.

baf25904:8b99119d94358a265ba628f8b2b16b1.title: Star External FLC Rental System Implementation
baf25904:8b99119d94358a265ba628f8b2b16b1.content: The implementation of the SEFLC rental system is defined as a Sky Primitive, specifically, the First Loss Capital Rental Primitive. See A.2.4 - First Loss Capital Rental Primitive.

baf25904:0407f9abc9ce30ea38568683768a68a.title: Tokenized External FLC System Implementation
baf25904:0407f9abc9ce30ea38568683768a68a.content: This document will be further developed in a future iteration of the Atlas.

baf25904:f9cb1bf72c34baa363b85da2d713a18.title: Burning of Existing Tokens
baf25904:f9cb1bf72c34baa363b85da2d713a18.content: At the same time that no new SKY tokens are issued, SKY tokens are bought back and burned on a regular basis, using a portion of the Net Revenue of the Protocol as dictated by the Treasury Management Function. See A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 4: Smart Burn And Standard Activity Staking Rewards - Smart Burn Buffer. As a result, the total supply of SKY tokens will continue to decrease over time.

baf25904:6a29cdfab859f079bfee76cab4b38ae.title: No New Token Emissions
baf25904:6a29cdfab859f079bfee76cab4b38ae.content: No new SKY tokens may be emitted except for (1) emissions required to recapitalize the protocol if it is at risk of insolvency (see A.3.7) and (2) temporary emissions that are being deprecated and fully offset by corresponding burns, resulting in no net increase to the intended long-term token supply (see A.4.1 - Core Tokens - SKY - Deprecated Emissions Mechanisms).

baf25904:f55b2e2516ad444e9cf0e0fef9c1e27.title: Deprecated Emissions Mechanisms
baf25904:f55b2e2516ad444e9cf0e0fef9c1e27.content: The subdocuments herein define legacy mechanisms involving the issuance of new SKY tokens. Each of these mechanisms is being deprecated. While these mechanisms do not increase the net supply of SKY tokens, they must be replaced with solutions that do not involve any emissions of SKY tokens, as defined in the documents herein.

baf25904:8e096f853f67e1b3e85305db451caff.title: Initial Token Supply
baf25904:8e096f853f67e1b3e85305db451caff.content: The initial token supply of SKY tokens is derived from the total number of legacy MKR tokens as of the launch of Sky, multiplied by the conversion ratio of 24,000. SKY is the exclusive governance token of the Sky Protocol and takes over all governance and economic rights previously held by MKR. See A.4.1 - Core Tokens - SKY - MKR To SKY Upgrade Approval.

baf25904:3f99688ecf247c4be2db3e074a2c578.title: SKY Token Rewards Emissions
baf25904:3f99688ecf247c4be2db3e074a2c578.content:
USDS users are able to earn SKY Rewards. See A.4.3 - A2 - Savings Rate And Token Reward Mechanism - Token Reward Mechanism. These rewards are currently funded by emissions of new SKY tokens.

These ongoing emissions will be eliminated and replaced with a solution that funds these rewards using SKY held by the Sky Protocol.

At the same time that this new solution is implemented, SKY tokens equal to the total SKY emissions previously used to fund SKY Rewards, including the Early Bird Reward (see A.5.5 - Accessibility Campaigns - Early Bird Reward - Token Distribution), will be burned from SKY held by the Sky Protocol.

The combination of these actions will achieve a state where the number of total SKY tokens is exactly the same as if SKY Rewards had never been funded with protocol emissions.

baf25904:f6c774566b7008c34e23d5e79fcbd13.title: Deflationary Tokenomics
baf25904:f6c774566b7008c34e23d5e79fcbd13.content: The documents herein set forth the core deflationary tokenomics of the SKY token.

baf25904:749f8a4159372fba4b374b6d2577ca6.title: MKR To SKY Conversion Emissions
baf25904:749f8a4159372fba4b374b6d2577ca6.content:
The legacy MKR to SKY conversion contract (Legacy Conversion Contract) burns MKR and mints new SKY. The new MKR to SKY conversion contract (New Conversion Contract) instead burns MKR and issues SKY from the existing supply of preminted SKY.

The Legacy Conversion Contract will be disabled as soon as practicable. To offset SKY minted by the Legacy Conversion Contract after the deployment of the New Conversion Contract, an equivalent amount of preminted SKY will be burned. This action will ensure the total SKY token supply remains as if these specific emissions from the Legacy Conversion Contract had not occurred.

baf25904:1b024af1cdc90c6ae7cb47418675ad7.title: Governance Accessibility Rewards Paid To Star Agents
baf25904:1b024af1cdc90c6ae7cb47418675ad7.content: 0.5% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to Star Agents that manage the rewards for Governance Integrators, incentivizing the active participation of Star Agents. See A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 1: Security and Stability Maintenance - Governance Accessibility Rewards Paid To Integrators.

baf25904:f95d85532de23b1c9c2a29a71599e7d.title: Governance Accessibility Rewards Paid To Integrators
baf25904:f95d85532de23b1c9c2a29a71599e7d.content: 0.5% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to frontends and other Integrators that facilitate accessible governance, following security and information standards specified in the Atlas. These standards will be specified in a future iteration of the Atlas. See A.2.4 - Core Governance Reward Primitive.

baf25904:9f3eef5c1781c063ad161e7e4db7fd3.title: Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards
baf25904:9f3eef5c1781c063ad161e7e4db7fd3.content: 5% of the Step 2 Capital is allocated to High Activity Staking Rewards (”HASR”) as specified in the documents herein. The remaining 95% of Step 2 Capital becomes Step 3 Capital.

baf25904:dcc71e080c0f5a97b84b59ab85176c9.title: Voluntary Reduction By Aligned Delegates
baf25904:dcc71e080c0f5a97b84b59ab85176c9.content: Aligned Delegates may agree to voluntarily reduce their compensation in order to incentivize SKY holders to delegate to them. To the extent that Aligned Delegates reduce their compensation, Step 2 Capital is increased by a corresponding amount. The mechanism by which Aligned Delegates may agree to reduce their compensation will be specified in a future iteration of the Atlas.

baf25904:20bf8eeb257dfc45f2e3da9373f3070.title: Purpose
baf25904:20bf8eeb257dfc45f2e3da9373f3070.content: High Activity Staking Rewards provide a boosted staking reward to SKY stakers that delegate their SKY through compliant Governance Accessibility frontends and provide feedback to their delegates every three (3) months. This ensures that there is a minimum amount of SKY that is always actively following current events and governance to detect potential misalignment or buildup of hidden risks.

baf25904:189c5bcbb7ac8afbe12e1f40865c137.title: Aligned Delegates
baf25904:189c5bcbb7ac8afbe12e1f40865c137.content: Up to 1% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to Aligned Delegates.

baf25904:f00f2441e3d63b99815b2cb90b7c2e5.title: Funding Of High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer
baf25904:f00f2441e3d63b99815b2cb90b7c2e5.content: 5% of the Step 2 Capital is allocated to funding the High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer (HASRB) linearly over the course of the month. Funds from the High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer are then paid out to Governance Accessibility Integrators as specified in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards - Payout From High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer. Governance Accessibility Integrators are in turn responsible for distributing those funds to High Activity Stakers as specified in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards - High Activity Staker Qualification.

baf25904:7deb39459ac0849ae2e7c9350c24d02.title: Treasury Management Function-Derived Voting Rewards
baf25904:7deb39459ac0849ae2e7c9350c24d02.content: USDS rewards are distributed via two distinct mechanisms based on the staker’s activity level: the High Activity Staking Reward (HASR) and the Standard Activity Staking Reward (SASR). SASR is the base reward when funding from the Treasury Management Function is available; HASR is an additional boost reserved for High-Activity wallets. See A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards - Payout From High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer.

baf25904:9dcff0e858ec349f038642b30be3f32.title: Sources of Voting Rewards
baf25904:9dcff0e858ec349f038642b30be3f32.content: SKY stakers are eligible to receive voting rewards sourced from the Sky Treasury Management Function (TMF) or the Agent Token Distribution mechanism defined in A.4.5.

baf25904:ce90d8d08aad98fcaa351c3ff1cb658.title: Activity Levels
baf25904:ce90d8d08aad98fcaa351c3ff1cb658.content: At the Monthly Settlement Cycle, all SKY-staking wallets are tagged as High Activity or Standard Activity, pursuant to the criteria defined in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards - High Activity Staker Qualification and A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 4: Smart Burn And Standard Activity Staking Rewards - Standard Activity Staking Rewards - Standard Activity Staker Qualification. Only High Activity wallets share HASR; both High and Standard Activity wallets share SASR.

baf25904:bfb838bcab76bf54c14bf8554fb6555.title: SKY Staking Voting Rewards
baf25904:bfb838bcab76bf54c14bf8554fb6555.content: The documents herein define the SKY Staking Voting Rewards. SKY stakers may choose between receiving USDS or Agent Token rewards.

baf25904:14629e34d62c931a9f40a4d9305ad3b.title: High Activity Staking Rewards
baf25904:14629e34d62c931a9f40a4d9305ad3b.content: The High Activity Staking Rewards (HASR) is a boosted reward provided to High Activity wallets. The HASR amount is distributed each monthly cycle pro-rata to the SKY stake of all High Activity wallets. High Activity wallets receive SASR (when funding is available) plus their separate HASR boost.

baf25904:75b465748b4aa847e0eaec3699f91dc.title: SKY Staking
baf25904:75b465748b4aa847e0eaec3699f91dc.content: SKY holders can stake their tokens via the SKY Staking Mechanism available on Ethereum Mainnet and SkyLink Deployments. SKY stakers earn voting rewards sourced from the Sky Treasury Management Function. In lieu of USDS rewards, SKY stakers can choose to earn Agent Token Rewards, including SPK and the tokens of other Star Agents incubated by the Launch Project. SKY stakers can also borrow USDS against their staked collateral using the SKY-backed borrowing mechanism defined herein.

baf25904:dfed3689377817397d2daee88790534.title: Standard Activity Staking Rewards
baf25904:dfed3689377817397d2daee88790534.content: The Standard Activity Staking Rewards (SASR) is the base reward shared by all wallets with Standard Activity status or higher. When funding is available, the SASR amount is distributed each monthly cycle pro‑rata to the SKY stake of every Standard or High Activity wallet.

baf25904:8f38c99b2ff7bc65290b75e9e11e72f.title: Net Revenue
baf25904:8f38c99b2ff7bc65290b75e9e11e72f.content: Net Revenue is equal to Income minus Expenses. Income is defined in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 0: Net Revenue - Income. Expenses are defined in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 0: Net Revenue - Expenses. Income and Expenses are defined such that Net Revenue must always be positive.

baf25904:4a20fea9b55350f384632241d2bba57.title: Step 0: Net Revenue
baf25904:4a20fea9b55350f384632241d2bba57.content: The sole function of Step 0 is to establish the Net Revenue of the Sky Protocol. It performs no allocations to downstream functions or buffers, unlike subsequent steps for which this Net Revenue serves as the input.

baf25904:4885672d7a302965a2e0a827a81548d.title: Income
baf25904:4885672d7a302965a2e0a827a81548d.content: The documents herein define each of the components of the Income of the Sky Protocol. These components are added together to arrive at total Income.

baf25904:5c9a20ac0192932ef5805678349af21.title: Allocation Steps
baf25904:5c9a20ac0192932ef5805678349af21.content: The documents herein define the allocation steps of the Sky Treasury Management Function. The process is divided into steps beginning with Net Revenue. These steps form a “waterfall” with each previous step needing to be fully funded before any funds can be allocated to later steps.

baf25904:8f4f224b47722710ac5c9878c8f7597.title: Stability Fees From Base Rate
baf25904:8f4f224b47722710ac5c9878c8f7597.content: Stability Fees are the fees that Sky Core charges Star Agents to borrow from Sky. See A.3.2 - Core Stability Parameters - Parameters - Base Rate. Sky Core’s legacy ALM infrastructure is currently being transferred to Star Agents; during this transition period and until this transfer is fully complete, income generated from the Sky Core Collateral Portfolio contributes to net revenue. See A.3.4 - Application To Sky Core.

baf25904:8eb274e094519504cf6ca26c4f14496.title: Integration With Monthly Settlement Cycle
baf25904:8eb274e094519504cf6ca26c4f14496.content: The Sky Treasury Management Function is synchronized with the Monthly Settlement Cycle. See A.2.6. At the conclusion of each MSC, the Net Revenue of the Sky Protocol for the preceding month is calculated and allocated according to the waterfall process defined in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps.

baf25904:169e81cfef5073c0741b0a82209c934.title: Internal Senior Risk Capital Income
baf25904:169e81cfef5073c0741b0a82209c934.content: Internal Senior Risk Capital income is the revenue attributed to Sky from the total payments made by Stars for Originated Senior Risk Capital (OSRC). ISRC itself comprises surplus capital allocated from designated buffers funded by the Sky Treasury Management Function. While Stars pay a single clearing price for their OSRC based on the monthly Origination Process, the total revenue received by Sky is subsequently allocated proportionally, with the portion corresponding to ISRC’s share of the Total Senior Risk Capital (TSRC) pool designated as ISRC Income. See A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Sourcing Of Internal Senior Risk Capital From Surplus Buffers.

baf25904:c4107a4fb7816296485aaeddf7d7494.title: Treasury Management
baf25904:c4107a4fb7816296485aaeddf7d7494.content: The documents herein define the Sky Treasury Management Function.

baf25904:adf942a36d8b7d1428ea504a8129690.title: Core Governance Reward Primitive
baf25904:adf942a36d8b7d1428ea504a8129690.content: The Core Governance Reward Primitive is a reward that Sky pays to Star Agents that provide SKY holders with secure access to the core Sky Governance features, ensuring that the Governance Security of Sky is maintained over time.

baf25904:21c99922cef397e46fe81e3174df827.title: Core Governance Primitives
baf25904:21c99922cef397e46fe81e3174df827.content: Core Governance Primitives allow Star Agents to earn incentives for maintaining and securing Sky Governance frontends as well as borrow from the Smart Burn Engine.

baf25904:bfdf6f76ae65e71a4c3972d156883e1.title: Sourcing Of Internal Senior Risk Capital From Surplus Buffers
baf25904:bfdf6f76ae65e71a4c3972d156883e1.content: Internal Senior Risk Capital (ISRC) consists of a portion of the excess capital of the Sky Protocol that is reinvested in providing Senior Risk Capital to Star Agents. ISRC is sourced from the various Buffers defined in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps, according to the specifications of the subdocuments below.

baf25904:74c8c2c4d95bb476016c6e50ce3d389.title: Standard Activity Staker Qualification
baf25904:74c8c2c4d95bb476016c6e50ce3d389.content: SKY that is both staked and delegated to an Aligned Delegate will qualify for Standard Activity Staking Rewards.
ancestors: Step 4: Smart Burn And Standard Activity Staking Rewards

baf25904:94482a3feca37f3bcaaf0ccac8c4a9b.title: USDS In High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer
baf25904:94482a3feca37f3bcaaf0ccac8c4a9b.content: All USDS in the High Activity Staking Rewards Buffer is used for Internal Senior Risk Capital.
ancestors: Sourcing Of Internal Senior Risk Capital From Surplus Buffers

baf25904:2121c7b3c831eb3b7841e08962c28f6.title: Payout From Standard Activity Staking Rewards Buffer
baf25904:2121c7b3c831eb3b7841e08962c28f6.content:
The Standard Activity Staking Reward Distribution occurs linearly over the course of each month. The monthly payout from the Standard Activity Staking Rewards Buffer (SASRB) is equal to the lesser of (1) 20% of Step 4 Capital, or (2) 15% of the SASRB, with a minimum floor of 5% of the SASRB.
In periods of high profitability, funds build up in the Standard Activity Staking Rewards Buffer. Then in periods of low profitability these funds are paid out from the Standard Activity Staking Rewards Buffer, ensuring that there is a continued incentive for involvement in governance even in periods of low profitability to maintain security.
ancestors: Step 4: Smart Burn And Standard Activity Staking Rewards

baf25904:3c5506700aded170b60a744dbede2fe.title: USDS In Standard Activity Staking Rewards Buffer
baf25904:3c5506700aded170b60a744dbede2fe.content: All USDS in the Standard Activity Staking Rewards Buffer is used for Internal Senior Risk Capital.
ancestors: Sourcing Of Internal Senior Risk Capital From Surplus Buffers

baf25904:78a15d345256b2304e7b76449a83878.title: Purpose
baf25904:78a15d345256b2304e7b76449a83878.content: Standard Activity Staking Rewards (SASR) provide rewards to users who contribute to security by staking and delegating their SKY votes at least once.
ancestors: Step 4: Smart Burn And Standard Activity Staking Rewards

baf25904:64b87e614eac8348c112789e9670ffc.title: USDS In Smart Burn Buffer
baf25904:64b87e614eac8348c112789e9670ffc.content: All USDS in the Smart Burn Buffer is used for Internal Senior Risk Capital.
ancestors: Sourcing Of Internal Senior Risk Capital From Surplus Buffers

baf25904:98aba395ec57913052bf359d5746082.title: Step 1: Security and Stability Maintenance
baf25904:98aba395ec57913052bf359d5746082.content: All of the Net Revenue from Step 0 (A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 0: Net Revenue) becomes Step 1 Capital. 10% of Step 1 Capital is allocated for security and stability maintenance as specified in the documents herein. The remaining 90% of Step 1 Capital becomes Step 2 Capital and is allocated as specified in A.2.5 - Treasury Management - Treasury Management - Allocation Steps - Step 2: High Activity Staking Rewards.

baf25904:ca235b13a8aa53c42d23e62d6f0bb12.title: Pioneer Rewards
baf25904:ca235b13a8aa53c42d23e62d6f0bb12.content: Pioneer Rewards are paid to Pioneer Stars as specified in A.2.4 - Pioneer Incentive Pool.

baf25904:7812badcb556e289ab2c0592a6a82f5.title: Core Executor Budget
baf25904:7812badcb556e289ab2c0592a6a82f5.content: Up to 5% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to the Core Executor Budget. This budget funds active Core Executor Agents responsible for the continuous improvement of the Atlas, including the risk management framework and other critical components.

baf25904:bf6da553a8e91db0fa407f3d5d5dc1b.title: Reimbursement Rewards
baf25904:bf6da553a8e91db0fa407f3d5d5dc1b.content: Reimbursement Rewards are paid to Star Agents to reimburse them for the costs of building common infrastructure used by the entire Sky Ecosystem, such as Token SkyLink deployments.

baf25904:b878890b00204d2f2603a10a7952cb4.title: Voluntary Reduction By Core Executor Agents
baf25904:b878890b00204d2f2603a10a7952cb4.content: Core Executor Agents may agree to voluntarily reduce their budget below 5% when applying for a Core Executor Slot in order to increase their chances of being elected to a Core Executor Slot. To the extent that Core Executor Agents reduce their budget, Step 2 Capital is increased by a corresponding amount. The mechanism by which Core Executor Agents are elected will be specified in a future iteration of the Atlas.

baf25904:ba01649ce174f4d4bb89901c1329e4a.title: Accessibility Rewards
baf25904:ba01649ce174f4d4bb89901c1329e4a.content: The Accessibility Reward is paid to Star Agents and third-party partners that drive adoption of USDS. See A.2.4 - Accessibility Reward Primitive.

baf25904:f87db0179f29176a8dcf34cc92139e4.title: Core Executor Reward
baf25904:f87db0179f29176a8dcf34cc92139e4.content: Up to 3% of Step 1 Capital is allocated to Core Executors whose terms have ended in the last four (4) years. This incentivizes Core Executors to increase the long term profitability of the Sky Ecosystem during their Core Executor Slot terms, as the Core Executor Reward is a percentage of future Net Revenue.

79abe87f:0407f9abc9ce30ea38568683768a68a.title: Tokenized External JRC System Implementation
79abe87f:0407f9abc9ce30ea38568683768a68a.content: This document will be further developed in a future iteration of the Atlas.

79abe87f:75c6015a8739870262786482b79faf0.title: Star External JRC Rental System Implementation
79abe87f:75c6015a8739870262786482b79faf0.content: The implementation of the SEJRC rental system is defined as a Sky Primitive, specifically, the Junior Risk Capital Rental Primitive. See A.2.4 - Junior Risk Capital Rental Primitive.

baf25904:987ed4d8201ee9cd2069aca5906e841.title: Monitoring As Part Of Settlement Cycle
baf25904:987ed4d8201ee9cd2069aca5906e841.content: Core GovOps reviews the calculation of Risk Capital by each Star Agent as part of the Settlement Cycle. In the event that it detects that Risk Capital requirements were violated, it applies the penalty mechanisms specified in A.3.3 - Risk Capital - Implementation - Monitoring And Penalty Mechanisms - Penalty Mechanisms.

baf25904:c53c4e081b8d27d7bdda3ad7f6d164e.title: Monitoring And Penalty Mechanisms
baf25904:c53c4e081b8d27d7bdda3ad7f6d164e.content: The documents herein define monitoring and penalty mechanisms.

baf25904:59903c6c305a33e5509ae68b16281e9.title: Penalty Mechanisms
baf25904:59903c6c305a33e5509ae68b16281e9.content: The documents herein specify the penalty mechanisms that exist to incentivize Star Agents and Operational Agents to ensure that sufficient capital is always held against investments by Star Agents and to protect Sky from risks due to insufficient capital.

baf25904:7befd1a2a741aa5a0d3cf137a8ee8fb.title: No Penalties For Changes In Methodology Or Governance Parameters In Near Term
baf25904:7befd1a2a741aa5a0d3cf137a8ee8fb.content: In the near term as the Risk Capital implementation continues to be developed, Star Agents will not be subject to penalties for failing to supply the incremental capital required by changes to the Risk Capital implementation. However, Operational GovOps must reduce the exposure to Allocation Conduits managed by the Star Agent to bring it back into compliance with capital requirements if the Star Agent does not work in good faith to provide the additional capital on the timeline specified above.
ancestors: Updates Due To Changed Methodology Or Governance Parameters

baf25904:08e9eb26bf9d3db2014e61115801c20.title: Penalty Mechanisms For Star Agents
baf25904:08e9eb26bf9d3db2014e61115801c20.content: The documents herein specify the penalty mechanisms for Star Agents for breaches of the Risk Capital requirements.

baf25904:d0423e55c3c5c7c94efdc0e5754e3b9.title: Phased Update To First Loss Capital Requirements For Changes In Methodology Or Governance Parameters
baf25904:d0423e55c3c5c7c94efdc0e5754e3b9.content: To the extent that a change to the implementation of the Risk Capital framework or a parameter set by Sky Governance changes the Risk Capital requirements, the additional Risk Capital required will phase in over time. The Star Agent must provide 50% of the additional Risk Capital within seven (7) calendar days of the change, and the remaining 50% on a pro rata basis over the following twenty one (21) calendar days.
ancestors: Updates Due To Changed Methodology Or Governance Parameters
